==================== service.py ====================
"""
MenuFlash — Service en salle : horaires d'ouverture + appel du serveur.

Branchement dans app.py, JUSTE AVANT `from backups import init_backups` :

    from service import init_service
    init_service(app, owner_required=owner_required,
                 active_restaurant=active_restaurant,
                 limiter=limiter, log_menu_change=log_menu_change)

1. HORAIRES D'OUVERTURE (page Boutique > Horaires d'ouverture)
   - Jusqu'à 2 créneaux par jour (ex : 11:00-15:00 et 18:00-23:30), avec les
     créneaux qui passent minuit (ex : 19:00-02:00).
   - Bouton « Suspendre les commandes maintenant » (cuisine débordée, panne…),
     avec un message optionnel pour les clients.
   - En dehors des horaires : le menu reste consultable, mais affiche
     « Fermé actuellement · Ouvre demain à 11:00 » et refuse les commandes.
     Le refus est appliqué CÔTÉ SERVEUR (pas seulement masqué à l'écran).
   - Tant que les horaires ne sont pas activés, rien ne change : le
     restaurant est considéré comme toujours ouvert.

2. APPEL DU SERVEUR / DEMANDE DE L'ADDITION
   - Deux boutons sur le menu du client, visibles seulement si sa table est
     connue (QR code de table) et si le restaurant est ouvert.
   - L'équipe (gestionnaire ET cuisiniers) voit l'appel sur toutes les pages
     du back-office, avec un son, en moins de 5 secondes, et le marque
     « Traité » d'un clic.

Sécurité
--------
- Appels clients : jeton CSRF obligatoire, limite de 6 appels / 10 min par
  appareil, un même appel répété pour la même table n'est enregistré qu'une
  fois, 40 appels en attente maximum par restaurant, et si le restaurant a
  des QR codes de table, seules ces tables sont acceptées (impossible
  d'inventer une table).
- Horaires : modifiables uniquement par le gestionnaire, valeurs strictement
  contrôlées (format HH:MM, 2 créneaux max, message limité et filtré).
- Appels : chaque compte ne voit et ne traite que ceux de son restaurant.
- Affichage : textes insérés par textContent (aucune injection HTML).
- Les données sont incluses dans les sauvegardes, et supprimées avec le
  restaurant (y compris la composition des plats, voir _cleanup_restaurant).

Heure : le Mali est à UTC+0 toute l'année. Pour un autre pays, définir
MENUFLASH_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES dans Render (ex : 60 pour UTC+1).
"""
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time as dtime

from flask import (render_template, request, redirect, url_for, flash, jsonify, abort)
from flask_login import current_user, login_required
from sqlalchemy import event

from models import db, Restaurant, QRCode

DAYS_FR = ["Lundi", "Mardi", "Mercredi", "Jeudi", "Vendredi", "Samedi", "Dimanche"]
DAYS_EN = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
MAX_SLOTS_PER_DAY = 2
CALL_KINDS = {"serveur": ("Appel serveur", "Waiter call"),
              "addition": ("Demande d'addition", "Bill request")}
CALL_VISIBLE_MINUTES = 30
CALL_DEDUP_MINUTES = 3
MAX_PENDING_CALLS = 40
_TIME_RE = re.compile(r"^([01]\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$")
_MESSAGE_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w\s'’\-.,!?:()/%&]*$", re.UNICODE)


def utc_offset():
    try:
        return timedelta(minutes=max(-720, min(int(os.environ.get("MENUFLASH_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES", "0")), 840)))
    except ValueError:
        return timedelta(0)


def local_now():
    return datetime.utcnow() + utc_offset()


# ==========================================================================
# Modèles (nouvelles tables uniquement, sans clé étrangère bloquante)
# ==========================================================================
class RestaurantHours(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "restaurant_hours"
    restaurant_id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    enabled = db.Column(db.Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    week = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False, default="{}")    # {"0": [["11:00","15:00"], ...], ...}
    suspended = db.Column(db.Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    suspended_message = db.Column(db.String(200))
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

    def slots(self):
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.week or "{}")
        except ValueError:
            data = {}
        out = {}
        for d in range(7):
            out[d] = [tuple(s) for s in data.get(str(d), [])
                      if isinstance(s, list) and len(s) == 2
                      and all(isinstance(x, str) and _TIME_RE.match(x) for x in s)][:MAX_SLOTS_PER_DAY]
        return out


class ServiceCall(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "service_calls"
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    restaurant_id = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False, index=True)
    table_label = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    kind = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False)
    status = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False, default="en_attente")
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, index=True, nullable=False)
    handled_at = db.Column(db.DateTime)
    handled_by = db.Column(db.String(120))


# ==========================================================================
# Calcul ouvert / fermé
# ==========================================================================
def _t(hhmm):
    h, m = hhmm.split(":")
    return dtime(int(h), int(m))


def _intervals_around(slots, now):
    """Créneaux concrets (début, fin) de la veille, du jour et des 7 jours suivants."""
    base = now.date()
    for offset in range(-1, 8):
        day = base + timedelta(days=offset)
        for start, end in slots.get(day.weekday(), []):
            s = datetime.combine(day, _t(start))
            e = datetime.combine(day, _t(end))
            if e <= s:                      # passe minuit
                e += timedelta(days=1)
            yield s, e


def opening_status(restaurant_id, now=None):
    """Renvoie {"open": bool, "reason": ..., "next": datetime|None, "message": ...}."""
    rec = RestaurantHours.query.get(restaurant_id)
    if rec is None:
        return {"open": True, "reason": None, "next": None, "message": None}
    if rec.suspended:
        return {"open": False, "reason": "suspended", "next": None, "message": rec.suspended_message}
    if not rec.enabled:
        return {"open": True, "reason": None, "next": None, "message": None}
    now = now or local_now()
    intervals = sorted(_intervals_around(rec.slots(), now))
    for s, e in intervals:
        if s <= now < e:
            return {"open": True, "reason": None, "next": None, "closes": e, "message": None}
    upcoming = [s for s, e in intervals if s > now]
    return {"open": False, "reason": "hours", "next": upcoming[0] if upcoming else None, "message": None}


def next_opening_text(nxt, now=None, lang="fr"):
    if nxt is None:
        return ""
    now = now or local_now()
    delta_days = (nxt.date() - now.date()).days
    hhmm = nxt.strftime("%H:%M")
    if lang == "en":
        when = "today" if delta_days == 0 else "tomorrow" if delta_days == 1 else DAYS_EN[nxt.weekday()]
        return f"Opens {when} at {hhmm}"
    when = "aujourd'hui" if delta_days == 0 else "demain" if delta_days == 1 else DAYS_FR[nxt.weekday()].lower()
    return f"Ouvre {when} à {hhmm}"


# ==========================================================================
# Validation du formulaire d'horaires
# ==========================================================================
class HoursError(ValueError):
    pass


def parse_week(form):
    week = {}
    for d in range(7):
        slots = []
        if form.get(f"closed_{d}"):
            week[str(d)] = []
            continue
        for n in range(1, MAX_SLOTS_PER_DAY + 1):
            start = (form.get(f"open_{d}_{n}") or "").strip()
            end = (form.get(f"close_{d}_{n}") or "").strip()
            if not start and not end:
                continue
            if not (_TIME_RE.match(start) and _TIME_RE.match(end)):
                raise HoursError(f"{DAYS_FR[d]} : heure invalide (format HH:MM, ex : 11:30).")
            if start == end:
                raise HoursError(f"{DAYS_FR[d]} : l'heure d'ouverture et de fermeture sont identiques.")
            slots.append([start, end])
        if len(slots) == 2:
            a, b = sorted(slots)
            a_end = datetime.combine(datetime.min.date(), _t(a[1]))
            if a[1] <= a[0]:
                raise HoursError(f"{DAYS_FR[d]} : seul le dernier créneau peut passer minuit.")
            if datetime.combine(datetime.min.date(), _t(b[0])) < a_end:
                raise HoursError(f"{DAYS_FR[d]} : les deux créneaux se chevauchent.")
            slots = [a, b]
        week[str(d)] = slots
    return week


def clean_message(raw):
    msg = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (raw or "")).strip()[:200]
    if msg and not _MESSAGE_RE.match(msg):
        raise HoursError("Le message contient des caractères non autorisés.")
    return msg or None


# ==========================================================================
# Branchement
# ==========================================================================
def init_service(app, *, owner_required, active_restaurant, limiter=None, log_menu_change=None):

    with app.app_context():
        for model in (RestaurantHours, ServiceCall):
            model.__table__.create(db.engine, checkfirst=True)

    # ---------------- Nettoyage à la suppression d'un restaurant ----------------
    def _cleanup_restaurant(rid):
        db.session.execute(RestaurantHours.__table__.delete().where(RestaurantHours.restaurant_id == rid))
        db.session.execute(ServiceCall.__table__.delete().where(ServiceCall.restaurant_id == rid))
        comp = db.metadata.tables.get("menu_item_compositions")
        if comp is not None:   # composition des plats : clé étrangère vers les plats
            db.session.execute(comp.delete().where(comp.c.restaurant_id == rid))

    original_delete = app.view_functions.get("super_admin_restaurant_delete")
    if original_delete is not None:
        def _delete_with_cleanup(restaurant_id):
            r = Restaurant.query.get(restaurant_id)
            if r is not None and request.method == "POST" and \
                    (request.form.get("confirm_slug") or "").strip() == r.slug:
                try:
                    from super_admin import RestaurantAdminMeta
                    meta = RestaurantAdminMeta.query.get(r.id)
                    if meta and meta.archived_at:
                        _cleanup_restaurant(r.id)
                except Exception:
                    db.session.rollback()
            return original_delete(restaurant_id=restaurant_id)
        app.view_functions["super_admin_restaurant_delete"] = _delete_with_cleanup

    # ---------------- Refus des commandes quand le restaurant est fermé ----------------
    ORDER_ENDPOINTS = {"place_order", "add_to_order"}

    @app.before_request
    def _enforce_opening_hours():
        if request.endpoint not in ORDER_ENDPOINTS or request.method != "POST":
            return None
        slug = (request.view_args or {}).get("slug")
        r = Restaurant.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first() if slug else None
        if r is None:
            return None
        st = opening_status(r.id)
        if st["open"]:
            return None
        msg = st["message"] or "Le restaurant ne prend pas de commandes pour le moment."
        if st["reason"] == "hours":
            msg = "Le restaurant est fermé actuellement." + (
                f" {next_opening_text(st['next'])}." if st["next"] else "")
        if request.headers.get("X-Requested-With") == "fetch" or request.is_json:
            return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": msg, "closed": True}), 409
        flash(msg, "error")
        return redirect(url_for("public_menu", slug=slug))

    # ---------------- Table du client (même logique que le menu public) ----------------
    def _resolve_table(restaurant):
        qr_id = request.values.get("qr", type=int) or request.values.get("qr_id", type=int)
        if qr_id:
            qr = QRCode.query.filter_by(id=qr_id, restaurant_id=restaurant.id).first()
            if qr:
                return qr.label
        label = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (request.values.get("t") or request.values.get("table_label") or "")).strip()[:50]
        if not label:
            return None
        if QRCode.query.filter_by(restaurant_id=restaurant.id).count():
            # Le restaurant utilise des QR de table : seules ses tables existent.
            if not QRCode.query.filter_by(restaurant_id=restaurant.id, label=label).first():
                return None
        return label

    # ---------------- Appel du serveur (client) ----------------
    def service_call(slug):
        r = Restaurant.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first_or_404()
        if not r.is_subscription_valid:
            abort(404)
        kind = request.form.get("kind", "")
        if kind not in CALL_KINDS:
            return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": "Demande invalide."}), 400
        if not opening_status(r.id)["open"]:
            return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": "Le restaurant est fermé actuellement."}), 409
        table = _resolve_table(r)
        if not table:
            return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": "Table inconnue : scannez le QR code de votre table."}), 400
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        recent = ServiceCall.query.filter(
            ServiceCall.restaurant_id == r.id, ServiceCall.table_label == table,
            ServiceCall.kind == kind, ServiceCall.status == "en_attente",
            ServiceCall.created_at >= now - timedelta(minutes=CALL_DEDUP_MINUTES)).first()
        if recent:
            return jsonify({"ok": True, "duplicate": True})
        pending = ServiceCall.query.filter(
            ServiceCall.restaurant_id == r.id, ServiceCall.status == "en_attente",
            ServiceCall.created_at >= now - timedelta(minutes=CALL_VISIBLE_MINUTES)).count()
        if pending >= MAX_PENDING_CALLS:
            return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": "Trop de demandes en cours, merci de patienter."}), 429
        db.session.add(ServiceCall(restaurant_id=r.id, table_label=table, kind=kind))
        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({"ok": True})

    view = service_call
    if limiter is not None:
        view = limiter.limit("6 per 10 minutes", methods=["POST"])(view)
    app.add_url_rule("/m/<slug>/appel", "service_call", view, methods=["POST"])

    # ---------------- Appels (équipe du restaurant) ----------------
    def _staff_restaurant():
        if not current_user.is_authenticated or getattr(current_user, "is_super_admin", False):
            abort(403)
        r = active_restaurant()
        if r is None:
            abort(403)
        return r

    @app.route("/admin/appels.json")
    @login_required
    def service_calls_feed():
        r = _staff_restaurant()
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        calls = (ServiceCall.query.filter(
            ServiceCall.restaurant_id == r.id, ServiceCall.status == "en_attente",
            ServiceCall.created_at >= now - timedelta(minutes=CALL_VISIBLE_MINUTES))
            .order_by(ServiceCall.created_at.asc()).limit(MAX_PENDING_CALLS).all())
        latest = db.session.query(db.func.max(ServiceCall.id)).filter(
            ServiceCall.restaurant_id == r.id).scalar() or 0
        resp = jsonify({"latest_id": latest, "calls": [{
            "id": c.id, "table": c.table_label, "kind": c.kind,
            "label": CALL_KINDS[c.kind][0] if c.kind in CALL_KINDS else c.kind,
            "minutes": max(int((now - c.created_at).total_seconds() // 60), 0),
        } for c in calls]})
        resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
        return resp

    @app.route("/admin/appels/<int:call_id>/traiter", methods=["POST"])
    @login_required
    def service_call_handle(call_id):
        r = _staff_restaurant()
        c = ServiceCall.query.filter_by(id=call_id, restaurant_id=r.id).first_or_404()
        if c.status == "en_attente":
            c.status = "traite"
            c.handled_at = datetime.utcnow()
            c.handled_by = current_user.email[:120]
            db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({"ok": True})

    # ---------------- Horaires (gestionnaire) ----------------
    @app.route("/admin/horaires", methods=["GET", "POST"])
    @owner_required
    def admin_hours():
        restaurant = active_restaurant()
        rec = RestaurantHours.query.get(restaurant.id)
        if request.method == "POST":
            action = request.form.get("action", "save")
            if rec is None:
                rec = RestaurantHours(restaurant_id=restaurant.id, week="{}")
                db.session.add(rec)
            try:
                if action == "suspend":
                    rec.suspended = True
                    rec.suspended_message = clean_message(request.form.get("message"))
                    note = "Commandes suspendues."
                elif action == "resume":
                    rec.suspended = False
                    rec.suspended_message = None
                    note = "Commandes reprises."
                else:
                    week = parse_week(request.form)
                    rec.enabled = bool(request.form.get("enabled"))
                    if rec.enabled and not any(week.values()):
                        raise HoursError("Indiquez au moins un créneau d'ouverture, ou désactivez les horaires.")
                    rec.week = json.dumps(week)
                    note = "Horaires d'ouverture " + ("activés et mis à jour." if rec.enabled else "désactivés.")
            except HoursError as exc:
                db.session.rollback()
                flash(str(exc), "error")
                return redirect(url_for("admin_hours"))
            if log_menu_change:
                log_menu_change(restaurant.id, current_user, "hours_updated", note)
            db.session.commit()
            flash(note, "success")
            return redirect(url_for("admin_hours"))

        slots = rec.slots() if rec else {d: [] for d in range(7)}
        st = opening_status(restaurant.id)
        return render_template(
            "admin_hours.html", restaurant=restaurant, rec=rec, slots=slots, days=DAYS_FR,
            status=st, next_text=next_opening_text(st.get("next")),
            now_local=local_now())

    # ---------------- Données pour les pages ----------------
    @app.context_processor
    def _inject_service():
        try:
            endpoint = request.endpoint or ""
            if endpoint == "public_menu":
                slug = (request.view_args or {}).get("slug")
                r = Restaurant.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first() if slug else None
                if r is None:
                    return {}
                st = opening_status(r.id)
                return {"mf_service": {
                    "mode": "public",
                    "call_url": url_for("service_call", slug=r.slug),
                    "table": _resolve_table(r),
                    "qr": request.args.get("qr", type=int),
                    "t": (request.args.get("t") or "")[:50],
                    "open": st["open"],
                    "reason": st["reason"],
                    "message": st["message"],
                    "next_fr": next_opening_text(st.get("next"), lang="fr"),
                    "next_en": next_opening_text(st.get("next"), lang="en"),
                }}
            if (current_user.is_authenticated and not getattr(current_user, "is_super_admin", False)
                    and (endpoint.startswith("admin_") or endpoint in ("change_password", "edit_item_composition"))
                    and endpoint not in ("admin_login", "admin_logout")):
                return {"mf_service": {
                    "mode": "staff",
                    "feed_url": url_for("service_calls_feed"),
                    "handle_url": "/admin/appels/{id}/traiter",
                }}
        except Exception:
            db.session.rollback()
        return {}

(function () {
  "use strict";

  (function installCsrfFetchGuard() {
    var nativeFetch = window.fetch;
    if (!nativeFetch || nativeFetch.__mfCsrfWrapped) return;

    function getCsrfToken() {
      var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
      return meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "";
    }

    function wrappedFetch(input, init) {
      init = init || {};
      var method = (init.method || "GET").toUpperCase();
      if (method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD") {
        var token = getCsrfToken();
        if (init.headers instanceof Headers) {
          if (!init.headers.has("X-CSRFToken")) init.headers.set("X-CSRFToken", token);
        } else {
          init.headers = init.headers || {};
          if (!("X-CSRFToken" in init.headers)) init.headers["X-CSRFToken"] = token;
        }
      }
      return nativeFetch(input, init);
    }
    wrappedFetch.__mfCsrfWrapped = true;
    window.fetch = wrappedFetch;
  })();

  function formatNumber(n) {
    return Math.round(n).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, " ");
  }

  function showToast(message, isError) {
    var container = document.getElementById("toast-container");
    if (!container || typeof bootstrap === "undefined") return;
    var icon = isError ? "bi-exclamation-circle-fill text-danger" : "bi-check-circle-fill text-success";
    var toastEl = document.createElement("div");
    toastEl.className = "toast align-items-center border-0 shadow mb-2";
    toastEl.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    toastEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="d-flex">' +
        '<div class="toast-body d-flex align-items-center gap-2">' +
          '<i class="bi ' + icon + '"></i><span>' + message + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn-close me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>' +
      '</div>';
    container.appendChild(toastEl);
    var toast = new bootstrap.Toast(toastEl, { delay: 6000 });
    toast.show();
  }
  window.MFShowToast = showToast;

  // Sons de l'équipe : voir static/sounds.js (cloche forte et agréable, volume réglable).
  function playNotificationSound(kind) {
    if (window.MFSound) window.MFSound.play(kind || "new_order");
  }

  function applyThemeVars(colors) {
    if (!colors) return;
    var root = document.documentElement;
    if (colors.accent) root.style.setProperty("--mf-accent", colors.accent);
    if (colors.accent_dark) root.style.setProperty("--mf-accent-dark", colors.accent_dark);
    if (colors.accent_light) root.style.setProperty("--mf-accent-light", colors.accent_light);

    if (window.MFPeakHoursChart && colors.accent) {
      window.MFPeakHoursChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = colors.accent;
      window.MFPeakHoursChart.update();
    }
  }
  window.MFApplyTheme = applyThemeVars;

  var MF_LANG_KEY = "mf_lang";

  function loadJsonScript(elementId) {
    var el = document.getElementById(elementId);
    if (!el) return null;
    try { return JSON.parse(el.textContent); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function getCurrentLang() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(MF_LANG_KEY) || "fr"; } catch (e) { return "fr"; }
  }

  function translateKey(key) {
    var dict = window.MF_I18N_DICT;
    var lang = getCurrentLang();
    if (!dict || !dict[lang] || !dict[lang][key]) return null;
    return dict[lang][key];
  }
  window.MFTranslate = translateKey;

  function applyLangToDom(lang) {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(function (el) {
      var key = el.getAttribute("data-i18n");
      var dict = window.MF_I18N_DICT;
      if (dict && dict[lang] && dict[lang][key] != null) {
        el.textContent = dict[lang][key];
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-placeholder]").forEach(function (el) {
      var key = el.getAttribute("data-i18n-placeholder");
      var dict = window.MF_I18N_DICT;
      if (dict && dict[lang] && dict[lang][key] != null) {
        el.setAttribute("placeholder", dict[lang][key]);
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-label]").forEach(function (el) {
      var key = el.getAttribute("data-i18n-label");
      var dict = window.MF_I18N_DICT;
      if (dict && dict[lang] && dict[lang][key] != null) {
        el.setAttribute("label", dict[lang][key]);
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-lang-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.lang === lang);
    });
  }

  function setLang(lang) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(MF_LANG_KEY, lang); } catch (e) {}
    applyLangToDom(lang);
  }
  window.MFSetLang = setLang;

  function initI18n() {
    var dict = loadJsonScript("mf-i18n-data");
    if (!dict) return;
    window.MF_I18N_DICT = dict;

    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-lang-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setLang(btn.dataset.lang);
      });
    });

    applyLangToDom(getCurrentLang());
  }

  function initToasts() {
    var dataEl = document.getElementById("flash-data");
    if (!dataEl) return;
    var messages;
    try { messages = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent); } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!Array.isArray(messages)) return;
    messages.forEach(function (pair, index) {
      setTimeout(function () { showToast(pair[1], pair[0] === "error"); }, index * 150);
    });
  }

  function initConfirmModal() {
    var modalEl = document.getElementById("mf-confirm-modal");
    if (!modalEl || typeof bootstrap === "undefined") return;
    var modal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);
    var messageEl = document.getElementById("mf-confirm-message");
    var confirmBtn = document.getElementById("mf-confirm-btn");
    var pendingForm = null;

    document.querySelectorAll("form.mf-confirm").forEach(function (form) {
      form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        pendingForm = form;
        messageEl.textContent = form.dataset.confirmMessage || "Confirmer cette action ?";
        modal.show();
      });
    });

    confirmBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      modal.hide();
      if (pendingForm) {
        pendingForm.submit();
        pendingForm = null;
      }
    });
  }

  function initCancelOrderModal() {
    var modalEl = document.getElementById("cancel-order-modal");
    if (!modalEl || typeof bootstrap === "undefined") return null;
    var modal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);
    var confirmBtn = document.getElementById("cancel-order-confirm-btn");
    var pendingCallback = null;

    confirmBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var labelEl = confirmBtn.querySelector(".confirm-label");
      var spinnerEl = confirmBtn.querySelector(".spinner-border");
      if (spinnerEl) spinnerEl.classList.remove("d-none");
      confirmBtn.disabled = true;

      var cb = pendingCallback;
      pendingCallback = null;

      var finish = function () {
        confirmBtn.disabled = false;
        if (spinnerEl) spinnerEl.classList.add("d-none");
        modal.hide();
      };

      if (cb) {
        cb(finish);
      } else {
        finish();
      }
    });

    return function requestCancelConfirmation(onConfirmed) {
      pendingCallback = onConfirmed;
      modal.show();
    };
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     SÉLECTEUR DE RESTAURANT — ouverture de la modale "Nouveau restaurant"
     depuis l'item "Nouveau restaurant" du dropdown. Ferme explicitement
     le dropdown AVANT d'ouvrir la modale (corrige un bug Bootstrap connu
     où les deux widgets se disputent focus/backdrop si ouverts en même
     temps depuis un data-bs-toggle imbriqué).
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function initRestaurantSwitcherModal() {
    var openBtn = document.getElementById("open-new-restaurant-modal-btn");
    var modalEl = document.getElementById("new-restaurant-modal");
    if (!openBtn || !modalEl || typeof bootstrap === "undefined") return;

    openBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var toggleBtn = document.getElementById("mf-restaurant-switcher-toggle");
      var dropdownInstance = toggleBtn ? bootstrap.Dropdown.getInstance(toggleBtn) : null;
      var modalShown = false;

      function showModalOnce() {
        if (modalShown) return;
        modalShown = true;
        bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl).show();
      }

      if (dropdownInstance && toggleBtn.classList.contains("show")) {
        toggleBtn.addEventListener("hidden.bs.dropdown", showModalOnce, { once: true });
        dropdownInstance.hide();
        setTimeout(showModalOnce, 300);
      } else {
        showModalOnce();
      }
    });
  }

  function initOrderCartAndMyOrders(requestCancelConfirmation) {
    var form = document.getElementById("order-form");
    if (!form) return;

    var slug = form.dataset.slug;
    var currency = form.dataset.currency || "";
    var storageKey = "mf_orders_" + slug;

    var cartBar = document.getElementById("cart-bar");
    var countEl = document.getElementById("cart-count");
    var totalEl = document.getElementById("cart-total");
    var submitBtn = document.getElementById("cart-submit");
    var submitLabelEl = document.getElementById("cart-submit-label");

    var myOrdersList = document.getElementById("my-orders-list");
    var myOrdersEmpty = document.getElementById("my-orders-empty");
    var myOrdersBadge = document.getElementById("my-orders-badge");

    var addmodeBanner = document.getElementById("addmode-banner");
    var addmodeOrderRef = document.getElementById("addmode-order-ref");
    var addmodeCancelBtn = document.getElementById("addmode-cancel");

    var addModeOrderId = null;

    var suggestionsDict = loadJsonScript("mf-suggestions-data") || {};
    var nudgedItemIds = new Set();

    function getSuggestionsFor(itemId) {
      return suggestionsDict[String(itemId)] || [];
    }

    function computeUpsellSuggestions(cartItemIds) {
      var inCart = new Set(cartItemIds);
      var seen = new Set();
      var result = [];
      cartItemIds.forEach(function (id) {
        getSuggestionsFor(id).forEach(function (sug) {
          if (!inCart.has(sug.id) && !seen.has(sug.id)) {
            seen.add(sug.id);
            result.push(sug);
          }
        });
      });
      return result.slice(0, 4);
    }

    function getStoredIds() {
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        var ids = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
        return Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : [];
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }
    function addStoredId(id) {
      var ids = getStoredIds();
      if (ids.indexOf(id) === -1) {
        ids.push(id);
        try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(ids)); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }

    function cartArticleLabel(count) {
      var key = count > 1 ? "cart_article_other" : "cart_article_one";
      return translateKey(key) || (count > 1 ? "articles" : "article");
    }

    function readCart() {
      var count = 0, total = 0, lines = [], ids = [];
      form.querySelectorAll(".mf-qty-group").forEach(function (group) {
        var qty = parseInt(group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value").textContent, 10) || 0;
        var price = parseInt(group.dataset.price, 10) || 0;
        var name = group.dataset.name || "";
        var itemId = parseInt(group.dataset.itemId, 10);
        if (qty > 0) {
          count += qty;
          total += qty * price;
          lines.push({ name: name, qty: qty, price: price });
          if (!isNaN(itemId)) ids.push(itemId);
        }
      });
      return { count: count, total: total, lines: lines, ids: ids };
    }

    function updateCartUI() {
      var cart = readCart();
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = cart.count + " " + cartArticleLabel(cart.count);
      if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = formatNumber(cart.total) + " " + currency;
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = cart.count === 0;
      if (cartBar) cartBar.classList.toggle("is-visible", cart.count > 0);
      return cart;
    }

    function resetCart() {
      form.querySelectorAll(".mf-qty-group").forEach(function (group) {
        group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value").textContent = "0";
        group.querySelector("input[type=hidden]").value = "0";
      });
      updateCartUI();
    }

    function incrementItemQty(itemId) {
      var group = form.querySelector('.mf-qty-group[data-item-id="' + itemId + '"]');
      if (!group) return;
      var valueEl = group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value");
      var hiddenInput = group.querySelector("input[type=hidden]");
      var newQty = Math.min((parseInt(hiddenInput.value, 10) || 0) + 1, 50);
      hiddenInput.value = newQty;
      valueEl.textContent = newQty;
      valueEl.classList.remove("mf-pop");
      void valueEl.offsetWidth;
      valueEl.classList.add("mf-pop");
    }

    form.querySelectorAll(".mf-qty-group").forEach(function (group) {
      var valueEl = group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value");
      var hiddenInput = group.querySelector("input[type=hidden]");
      var minusBtn = group.querySelector(".mf-qty-minus");
      var plusBtn = group.querySelector(".mf-qty-plus");
      var itemId = parseInt(group.dataset.itemId, 10);

      function setQty(q) {
        var previous = parseInt(hiddenInput.value, 10) || 0;
        q = Math.max(0, Math.min(50, q));
        valueEl.textContent = q;
        hiddenInput.value = q;
        valueEl.classList.remove("mf-pop");
        void valueEl.offsetWidth;
        valueEl.classList.add("mf-pop");
        updateCartUI();

        if (previous === 0 && q > 0 && !isNaN(itemId) && !nudgedItemIds.has(itemId)) {
          var cart = readCart();
          var sugg = computeUpsellSuggestions(cart.ids).filter(function (s) {
            return getSuggestionsFor(itemId).some(function (own) { return own.id === s.id; });
          });
          if (sugg.length > 0) {
            nudgedItemIds.add(itemId);
            var prefix = translateKey("upsell_nudge_prefix") || "💡 Nos clients ajoutent souvent :";
            var names = sugg.map(function (s) { return s.name; }).join(", ");
            showToast(prefix + " " + names, false);
          }
        }
      }

      minusBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setQty((parseInt(hiddenInput.value, 10) || 0) - 1);
      });
      plusBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setQty((parseInt(hiddenInput.value, 10) || 0) + 1);
      });
    });

    function enterAddMode(orderId, tableLabel) {
      addModeOrderId = orderId;
      resetCart();
      if (addmodeBanner) {
        addmodeBanner.classList.remove("d-none");
        if (addmodeOrderRef) {
          addmodeOrderRef.textContent = "#" + orderId + (tableLabel ? " · " + tableLabel : "");
        }
      }
      if (submitLabelEl) submitLabelEl.textContent = (translateKey("add_dishes_btn") || "Ajouter à la commande") + " #" + orderId;
      if (cartBar) cartBar.classList.add("mf-cart-addmode");

      var offcanvasEl = document.getElementById("my-orders-offcanvas");
      if (offcanvasEl && typeof bootstrap !== "undefined") {
        var instance = bootstrap.Offcanvas.getInstance(offcanvasEl);
        if (instance) instance.hide();
      }
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    }

    function exitAddMode() {
      addModeOrderId = null;
      if (addmodeBanner) addmodeBanner.classList.add("d-none");
      if (submitLabelEl) submitLabelEl.textContent = translateKey("cart_submit_default") || "Voir ma commande";
      if (cartBar) cartBar.classList.remove("mf-cart-addmode");
      resetCart();
    }

    if (addmodeCancelBtn) {
      addmodeCancelBtn.addEventListener("click", exitAddMode);
    }

    var recapModalEl = document.getElementById("order-recap-modal");
    var recapBody = document.getElementById("order-recap-body");
    var recapTitle = document.getElementById("order-recap-title");
    var recapConfirmBtn = document.getElementById("order-recap-confirm");
    var recapModal = (recapModalEl && typeof bootstrap !== "undefined")
      ? new bootstrap.Modal(recapModalEl) : null;

    function renderRecap() {
      var cart = updateCartUI();

      if (recapTitle) {
        recapTitle.textContent = addModeOrderId
          ? "#" + addModeOrderId + " — " + (translateKey("recap_total_added") || "Total ajouté")
          : (translateKey("recap_title_default") || "Récapitulatif de votre commande");
      }

      var totalLabel = addModeOrderId
        ? (translateKey("recap_total_added") || "Total ajouté")
        : (translateKey("recap_total") || "Total");

      var html = '<ul class="list-group list-group-flush mb-3">';
      cart.lines.forEach(function (line) {
        html += '<li class="list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between px-0">' +
          '<span>' + line.qty + ' × ' + line.name + '</span>' +
          '<span class="fw-semibold">' + formatNumber(line.qty * line.price) + ' ' + currency + '</span>' +
          '</li>';
      });
      html += '</ul><div class="d-flex justify-content-between fw-bold fs-5">' +
        '<span>' + totalLabel + '</span>' +
        '<span>' + formatNumber(cart.total) + ' ' + currency + '</span></div>';

      var upsell = computeUpsellSuggestions(cart.ids);
      if (upsell.length > 0) {
        var upsellTitle = translateKey("upsell_title") || "Vous pourriez aussi aimer";
        var addLabel = translateKey("upsell_add_btn") || "Ajouter";
        html += '<div class="mf-upsell-section">' +
          '<div class="mf-upsell-title"><i class="bi bi-stars"></i>' + upsellTitle + '</div>';
        upsell.forEach(function (sug) {
          html += '<div class="mf-upsell-item">' +
            '<span><span class="mf-upsell-name">' + sug.name + '</span>' +
            '<span class="mf-upsell-price">' + formatNumber(sug.price) + ' ' + currency + '</span></span>' +
            '<button type="button" class="mf-upsell-add-btn" data-suggest-id="' + sug.id + '">' +
            '<i class="bi bi-plus-lg me-1"></i>' + addLabel + '</button>' +
            '</div>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
      }

      recapBody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    if (recapBody) {
      recapBody.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest(".mf-upsell-add-btn");
        if (!btn) return;
        var suggestId = parseInt(btn.dataset.suggestId, 10);
        incrementItemQty(suggestId);
        renderRecap();
      });
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       Envoi de la commande.
       - QR code d'une table : récapitulatif -> « Confirmer l'envoi ».
       - Lien général (à emporter) : récapitulatif -> « Continuer » ->
         fenêtre « À emporter » (takeaway.js) -> « Confirmer la commande ».
       - Ajout à une commande existante : toujours directement.
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    function isTakeawayFlow() {
      return !addModeOrderId && !!(window.MFTakeaway && window.MFTakeaway.active);
    }

    function recapConfirmText() {
      return isTakeawayFlow()
        ? (translateKey("cart_continue") || "Continuer")
        : (translateKey("cart_submit_confirm") || "Confirmer l'envoi");
    }

    function setRecapBusy(busy) {
      var labelEl = recapConfirmBtn.querySelector(".confirm-label");
      var spinnerEl = recapConfirmBtn.querySelector(".spinner-border");
      recapConfirmBtn.disabled = busy;
      if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = busy ? (translateKey("cart_sending") || "Envoi…") : recapConfirmText();
      if (spinnerEl) spinnerEl.classList.toggle("d-none", !busy);
    }

    // Envoie la commande. Renvoie une promesse { ok, error, handled }.
    // Dans le parcours « à emporter », les erreurs sont affichées dans la fenêtre.
    function sendOrder() {
      var takeaway = isTakeawayFlow();
      var targetUrl = addModeOrderId
        ? "/m/" + slug + "/commande/" + addModeOrderId + "/ajouter"
        : form.action;

      return fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" },
        body: new FormData(form)
      })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (data) { return { ok: r.ok, data: data }; }); })
        .then(function (res) {
          var data = res.data || {};
          if (!data.ok) {
            if (data.locked) {
              showToast(data.error, true);
              exitAddMode();
              refreshMyOrders();
              return { ok: false, handled: true, error: data.error };
            }
            var message = data.error || "Une erreur est survenue.";
            if (!takeaway) showToast(message, true);
            return { ok: false, error: message };
          }

          if (addModeOrderId) {
            showToast("Plats ajoutés à la commande #" + data.id + ".", false);
            exitAddMode();
          } else {
            addStoredId(data.id);
            resetCart();
            if (takeaway && data.detail_url) {
              window.location.href = data.detail_url;
              return { ok: true };
            }
            showToast("Commande envoyée ! Suivez-la dans « Mes commandes ».", false);
          }

          refreshMyOrders();
          var offcanvasEl = document.getElementById("my-orders-offcanvas");
          if (offcanvasEl && typeof bootstrap !== "undefined") {
            bootstrap.Offcanvas.getOrCreateInstance(offcanvasEl).show();
          }
          return { ok: true };
        })
        .catch(function () {
          var message = "Impossible d'envoyer la commande. Vérifiez votre connexion.";
          if (!takeaway) showToast(message, true);
          return { ok: false, error: message };
        });
    }

    if (submitBtn && recapModal) {
      submitBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var cart = updateCartUI();
        if (cart.count === 0) return;
        renderRecap();
        setRecapBusy(false);
        recapModal.show();
      });

      recapConfirmBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (isTakeawayFlow()) {
          var cart = readCart();
          var summary = cart.count + " " + cartArticleLabel(cart.count) + " · " +
                        formatNumber(cart.total) + " " + currency;
          recapModalEl.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", function () {
            window.MFTakeaway.open(sendOrder, summary);
          }, { once: true });
          recapModal.hide();
          return;
        }
        setRecapBusy(true);
        sendOrder().then(function (res) {
          setRecapBusy(false);
          if (res.ok || res.handled) recapModal.hide();
        });
      });
    }

    function statusLabel(status) {
      return translateKey("status_" + status) || status;
    }

    function cancelOrder(orderId, onDone) {
      fetch("/m/" + slug + "/commande/" + orderId + "/annuler-client", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" }
      })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          if (data.ok) {
            showToast(translateKey("cancel_order_success") || "Commande annulée.", false);
          } else if (data.locked) {
            showToast(translateKey("cancel_order_locked") || "Trop tard : cette commande est déjà en préparation.", true);
          } else {
            showToast(data.error || "Impossible d'annuler cette commande.", true);
          }
          refreshMyOrders();
          if (onDone) onDone();
        })
        .catch(function () {
          showToast("Impossible d'annuler la commande. Vérifiez votre connexion.", true);
          if (onDone) onDone();
        });
    }

    function renderMyOrder(order) {
      var itemsHtml = order.items.map(function (it) {
        return "<li>" + it.quantity + " × " + it.name + "</li>";
      }).join("");
      var noteHtml = order.notes ? '<p class="text-secondary small mb-2">📝 ' + order.notes + "</p>" : "";
      var detailUrl = "/m/" + slug + "/commande/" + order.id;

      var actionsHtml = "";
      if (order.editable) {
        actionsHtml =
          '<div class="mf-myorder-actions">' +
            '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mf-myorder-addbtn mf-addto-btn" ' +
            'data-order-id="' + order.id + '" data-table-label="' + (order.table_label || "") + '">' +
            '<i class="bi bi-plus-lg me-1"></i>' + (translateKey("add_dishes_btn") || "Ajouter des plats") + '</button>' +
            '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm mf-myorder-cancelbtn mf-cancel-order-trigger" ' +
            'data-order-id="' + order.id + '">' +
            '<i class="bi bi-x-circle me-1"></i>' + (translateKey("cancel_order_btn") || "Annuler la commande") + '</button>' +
          '</div>';
      }

      return (
        '<div class="card mf-myorder-card" data-order-id="' + order.id + '">' +
          '<div class="card-body">' +
            '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">' +
              '<span class="badge mf-status-badge mf-status-' + order.status + '">' + statusLabel(order.status) + '</span>' +
              (order.reference
                ? '<span class="small text-secondary mf-myorder-ref">' + escapeHtml(order.reference.slice(0, -3)) +
                  '<strong>' + escapeHtml(order.reference.slice(-3)) + '</strong></span>'
                : '<span class="small text-secondary">#' + order.id + '</span>') +
            '</div>' +
            '<ul class="mf-myorder-items">' + itemsHtml + '</ul>' +
            noteHtml +
            '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">' +
              '<span class="mf-myorder-total">' + formatNumber(order.total) + ' ' + currency + '</span>' +
              '<a href="' + detailUrl + '" class="small">' + (translateKey("order_detail_link") || "Détail complet →") + '</a>' +
            '</div>' +
            actionsHtml +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function updateBadge(activeCount) {
      if (!myOrdersBadge) return;
      if (activeCount > 0) {
        myOrdersBadge.textContent = activeCount;
        myOrdersBadge.classList.remove("d-none");
      } else {
        myOrdersBadge.classList.add("d-none");
      }
    }

    function refreshMyOrders() {
      if (!myOrdersList) return;
      var ids = getStoredIds();
      if (ids.length === 0) {
        if (myOrdersEmpty) myOrdersEmpty.style.display = "";
        updateBadge(0);
        return;
      }
      fetch("/m/" + slug + "/commandes/etats.json?ids=" + ids.join(","))
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          var orders = data.orders || [];
          if (orders.length === 0) {
            if (myOrdersEmpty) myOrdersEmpty.style.display = "";
            myOrdersList.innerHTML = "";
            updateBadge(0);
            return;
          }
          if (myOrdersEmpty) myOrdersEmpty.style.display = "none";
          myOrdersList.innerHTML = orders.slice().reverse().map(renderMyOrder).join("");

          var activeCount = orders.filter(function (o) {
            return o.status !== "servie" && o.status !== "annulee";
          }).length;
          updateBadge(activeCount);
        })
        .catch(function () {});
    }

    if (myOrdersList) {
      myOrdersList.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var addBtn = e.target.closest(".mf-addto-btn");
        if (addBtn) {
          enterAddMode(parseInt(addBtn.dataset.orderId, 10), addBtn.dataset.tableLabel);
          return;
        }
        var cancelBtn = e.target.closest(".mf-cancel-order-trigger");
        if (cancelBtn && requestCancelConfirmation) {
          var orderId = parseInt(cancelBtn.dataset.orderId, 10);
          requestCancelConfirmation(function (finish) {
            cancelOrder(orderId, finish);
          });
        }
      });
    }

    updateCartUI();
    refreshMyOrders();
    setInterval(refreshMyOrders, 6000);
  }

  function initCategoryNav() {
    var navLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".mf-nav-pills .nav-link");
    if (!navLinks.length) return;
    var sections = Array.prototype.map.call(navLinks, function (link) {
      return document.querySelector(link.getAttribute("href"));
    });

    function onScroll() {
      var scrollPos = window.scrollY + 120;
      var activeIndex = 0;
      sections.forEach(function (sec, i) {
        if (sec && sec.offsetTop <= scrollPos) activeIndex = i;
      });
      navLinks.forEach(function (link, i) {
        link.classList.toggle("active", i === activeIndex);
      });
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
  }

  function initOrderStatusPolling(requestCancelConfirmation) {
    var root = document.getElementById("order-status-root");
    if (!root) return;
    var pollUrl = root.dataset.pollUrl;
    var cancelUrl = root.dataset.cancelUrl;
    var stepOrder = ["nouvelle", "en_preparation", "prete", "servie"];
    var badge = document.getElementById("status-badge");
    var progressBar = document.getElementById("status-progress-bar");
    var stepLabels = document.querySelectorAll(".mf-step-labels span");
    var cancelBtn = document.getElementById("cancel-order-btn");

    function applyStatus(status, label) {
      var translated = (window.MFTranslate && window.MFTranslate("status_" + status)) || label;
      badge.textContent = translated;
      badge.setAttribute("data-i18n", "status_" + status);
      badge.className = "mf-status-badge badge mf-status-" + status;
      var idx = stepOrder.indexOf(status);
      var pct = idx >= 0 ? ((idx + 1) / stepOrder.length) * 100 : 100;
      if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = pct + "%";
      stepLabels.forEach(function (el, i) {
        el.classList.toggle("active", i <= idx);
      });
    }

    if (cancelBtn && cancelUrl && requestCancelConfirmation) {
      cancelBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        requestCancelConfirmation(function (finish) {
          fetch(cancelUrl, { method: "POST", headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" } })
            .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function (data) {
              finish();
              if (data.ok) {
                showToast(translateKey("cancel_order_success") || "Commande annulée.", false);
                setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 800);
              } else if (data.locked) {
                showToast(translateKey("cancel_order_locked") || "Trop tard : cette commande est déjà en préparation.", true);
                setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 800);
              } else {
                showToast(data.error || "Impossible d'annuler cette commande.", true);
              }
            })
            .catch(function () {
              finish();
              showToast("Impossible d'annuler la commande. Vérifiez votre connexion.", true);
            });
        });
      });
    }

    var currentStatus = root.dataset.status;
    applyStatus(currentStatus, root.dataset.statusLabel);

    if (currentStatus === "servie" || currentStatus === "annulee") return;

    var interval = setInterval(function () {
      fetch(pollUrl).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (data) {
        if (data.status !== currentStatus) {
          currentStatus = data.status;
          applyStatus(data.status, data.status_label);
          badge.classList.add("mf-pulse");
          if (currentStatus === "servie" || currentStatus === "en_preparation") {
            setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 1200);
          }
        }
        if (currentStatus === "servie" || currentStatus === "annulee") {
          clearInterval(interval);
        }
      }).catch(function () {});
    }, 5000);
  }

  function initReviewForm() {
    var card = document.getElementById("review-card");
    if (!card) return;
    var submitUrl = card.dataset.submitUrl;
    var submitBtn = document.getElementById("review-submit-btn");
    var commentEl = document.getElementById("review-comment");

    card.querySelectorAll(".mf-star-picker").forEach(function (picker) {
      var hiddenInput = picker.querySelector("input[type=hidden]");
      var stars = Array.prototype.slice.call(picker.querySelectorAll(".mf-star"));

      function setRating(value) {
        hiddenInput.value = value;
        stars.forEach(function (star) {
          var starValue = parseInt(star.dataset.value, 10);
          star.classList.toggle("bi-star-fill", starValue <= value);
          star.classList.toggle("bi-star", starValue > value);
          star.classList.toggle("mf-star-filled", starValue <= value);
        });
      }

      stars.forEach(function (star) {
        star.addEventListener("click", function () {
          setRating(parseInt(star.dataset.value, 10));
        });
      });
    });

    if (submitBtn) {
      submitBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var formData = new FormData();
        card.querySelectorAll(".mf-star-picker input[type=hidden]").forEach(function (input) {
          formData.append(input.name, input.value);
        });
        if (commentEl) formData.append("comment", commentEl.value);

        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        fetch(submitUrl, { method: "POST", body: formData })
          .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
          .then(function (data) {
            if (data.ok) {
              var thanksText = (window.MFTranslate && window.MFTranslate("review_thanks")) || "Merci pour votre avis !";
              card.innerHTML = '<div class="card-body p-4 text-center" style="color: var(--mf-accent-dark);">' +
                '<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill me-2"></i>' + thanksText + '</div>';
            } else {
              submitBtn.disabled = false;
              showToast(data.error || "Impossible d'enregistrer votre avis.", true);
            }
          })
          .catch(function () {
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            showToast("Impossible d'enregistrer votre avis. Vérifiez votre connexion.", true);
          });
      });
    }
  }

  function initSortable() {
    if (typeof Sortable === "undefined") return;

    var catList = document.getElementById("categories-list");
    if (catList) {
      Sortable.create(catList, {
        handle: ".mf-drag-handle",
        animation: 180,
        onEnd: function () {
          var order = Array.prototype.map.call(
            catList.querySelectorAll(".mf-category-block"),
            function (el) { return el.dataset.id; }
          );
          fetch(catList.dataset.reorderUrl, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ order: order })
          });
        }
      });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-items-tbody").forEach(function (tbody) {
      Sortable.create(tbody, {
        handle: ".mf-drag-handle",
        animation: 180,
        onEnd: function () {
          var order = Array.prototype.map.call(
            tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"),
            function (el) { return el.dataset.id; }
          );
          fetch(tbody.dataset.reorderUrl, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ order: order, category_id: tbody.dataset.categoryId })
          });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  var kanbanRefreshFn = null;

  function initKitchenPolling() {
    var root = document.getElementById("kanban-root");
    if (!root) return;
    var feedUrl = root.dataset.feedUrl;
    var currency = root.dataset.currency || "";
    var knownIds = new Set(
      Array.prototype.map.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-order-id]"),
        function (el) { return el.dataset.orderId; })
    );

    var columnLabels = {
      nouvelle: { next: "Marquer en préparation" },
      en_preparation: { next: "Marquer prête" },
      prete: { next: "Marquer servie" }
    };

    function renderCard(order, nextLabel, isNew) {
      var itemsHtml = order.items.map(function (it) {
        return "<li>" + it.quantity + " × " + it.name + "</li>";
      }).join("");
      var noteHtml = order.notes ? '<p class="mf-order-note mb-2">📝 ' + order.notes + "</p>" : "";
      return (
        '<div class="card mf-order-card-k mb-2 ' + (isNew ? "mf-animate-in mf-pulse" : "") + '" data-order-id="' + order.id + '">' +
          '<div class="card-body p-3">' +
            '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">' +
              '<strong>' + order.table_label + '</strong>' +
              '<span class="mf-elapsed">' + order.elapsed_minutes + ' min</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<ul class="mb-2 ps-3 small">' + itemsHtml + '</ul>' +
            noteHtml +
            '<p class="fw-bold mb-2" style="color: var(--mf-accent-dark);">' +
              order.total.toLocaleString("fr-FR") + ' ' + currency +
            '</p>' +
            '<div class="d-flex gap-2">' +
              '<button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm flex-grow-1 mf-advance-btn" data-order-id="' + order.id + '">' + nextLabel + '</button>' +
              '<button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm mf-cancel-btn" data-order-id="' + order.id + '"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function attachActions(container) {
      container.querySelectorAll(".mf-advance-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          fetch("/admin/commandes/" + btn.dataset.orderId + "/avancer", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" }
          }).then(refresh);
        });
      });
      container.querySelectorAll(".mf-cancel-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          fetch("/admin/commandes/" + btn.dataset.orderId + "/annuler", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" }
          }).then(refresh);
        });
      });
    }

    function refresh() {
      fetch(feedUrl).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (data) {
        ["nouvelle", "en_preparation", "prete"].forEach(function (status) {
          var col = document.getElementById("col-" + status);
          if (!col) return;
          var orders = data.orders.filter(function (o) { return o.status === status; });
          var countEl = document.getElementById("count-" + status);
          if (countEl) countEl.textContent = orders.length;

          if (orders.length === 0) {
            col.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">Aucune commande.</p>';
            return;
          }
          col.innerHTML = orders.map(function (o) {
            var isNew = !knownIds.has(String(o.id));
            return renderCard(o, columnLabels[status].next, isNew);
          }).join("");
        });

        knownIds = new Set(data.orders.map(function (o) { return String(o.id); }));
        attachActions(root);
      }).catch(function () {});
    }

    function refreshWithCancelAnimation(orderId) {
      var card = root.querySelector('[data-order-id="' + orderId + '"]');
      if (card) {
        card.classList.add("mf-cancelling");
        setTimeout(refresh, 380);
      } else {
        refresh();
      }
    }

    attachActions(root);
    refresh();
    setInterval(refresh, 20000);

    kanbanRefreshFn = refresh;
    window.MFKanbanRefreshWithCancelAnimation = refreshWithCancelAnimation;
  }

  function initCopyButtons() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-copy-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var text = btn.dataset.copyText;
        if (!text) return;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () {
          var original = btn.innerHTML;
          btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> Copié';
          setTimeout(function () { btn.innerHTML = original; }, 1500);
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function initPaymentModal() {
    var modalEl = document.getElementById("payment-modal");
    if (!modalEl) return;
    var form = document.getElementById("payment-modal-form");
    var nameEl = document.getElementById("payment-modal-restaurant-name");

    modalEl.addEventListener("show.bs.modal", function (event) {
      var btn = event.relatedTarget;
      if (!btn) return;
      form.action = btn.dataset.actionUrl;
      nameEl.textContent = btn.dataset.restaurantName;
    });
  }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     SURVEILLANCE DES COMMANDES sur toutes les pages du back-office (hors
     page Commandes, qui a son propre temps réel SSE). Interroge un point
     de contrôle léger toutes les 8 s (30 s si l'onglet est en arrière-
     plan) et, à chaque nouvelle commande : son + notification + mise à
     jour du badge et du bandeau, sans recharger la page.
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function escapeHtml(text) {
    return String(text == null ? "" : text)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
  }

  function initGlobalOrderWatcher() {
    var el = document.getElementById("mf-order-watcher");
    if (!el) return;

    var url = el.dataset.url;
    var storageKey = "mf_last_order_id";
    var badge = document.getElementById("nav-orders-badge");
    var banner = document.getElementById("mf-orders-banner");
    var bannerText = document.getElementById("mf-orders-banner-text");
    var timer = null;
    var lastId = null;

    try {
      var stored = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (stored !== null) lastId = parseInt(stored, 10);
    } catch (e) {}

    function render(count) {
      if (badge) {
        badge.textContent = count;
        badge.classList.toggle("d-none", count === 0);
      }
      if (banner && bannerText) {
        bannerText.textContent = "Vous avez " + count + " commande" + (count > 1 ? "s" : "") + " en cours.";
        banner.classList.toggle("d-none", count === 0);
      }
    }

    function poll() {
      fetch(url, { cache: "no-store", headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" } })
        .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
        .then(function (data) {
          if (!data) return;
          render(data.count);

          if (lastId !== null && data.latest_id > lastId) {
            playNotificationSound();
            showToast(
              "🆕 Nouvelle commande · " + escapeHtml(data.latest_table) +
              ' — <a href="/admin/commandes" class="fw-bold">Voir</a>',
              false
            );
            if (badge) {
              badge.classList.remove("mf-pop");
              void badge.offsetWidth;
              badge.classList.add("mf-pop");
            }
          }

          lastId = data.latest_id;
          try { sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, String(lastId)); } catch (e) {}
        })
        .catch(function () { /* réseau indisponible : on réessaiera */ });
    }

    function schedule() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(poll, document.hidden ? 30000 : 8000);
    }

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
      if (!document.hidden) poll();
      schedule();
    });

    poll();
    schedule();
  }

  function initThemeLiveSync() {
    var el = document.getElementById("theme-sync-root") || document.getElementById("public-theme-sync-root");
    if (!el || typeof EventSource === "undefined") return;

    var streamUrl = el.dataset.streamUrl;
    var isAdminChannel = el.id === "theme-sync-root";
    var liveIndicator = document.getElementById("live-indicator");
    var reconnectDelay = 2000;

    function setLiveStatus(isLive) {
      if (!liveIndicator) return;
      liveIndicator.classList.toggle("mf-live-off", !isLive);
      liveIndicator.innerHTML = isLive
        ? '<span class="mf-live-dot"></span> En direct'
        : '<span class="mf-live-dot"></span> Reconnexion…';
    }

    function connect() {
      var source = new EventSource(streamUrl);

      source.onopen = function () {
        setLiveStatus(true);
        reconnectDelay = 2000;
      };

      source.onmessage = function (event) {
        var payload;
        try { payload = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch (e) { return; }

        if (payload.type === "theme_changed") {
          applyThemeVars(payload.data);
          if (isAdminChannel) showToast("🎨 Le thème a été mis à jour.", false);
          return;
        }

        if (!isAdminChannel) return;

        var tableInfo = (payload.data && payload.data.table_label) ? " · " + payload.data.table_label : "";

        if (payload.type === "new_order") {
          playNotificationSound();
          showToast("🆕 Nouvelle commande reçue" + tableInfo + " !", false);
          if (kanbanRefreshFn) kanbanRefreshFn();
        } else if (payload.type === "order_updated") {
          playNotificationSound("updated");
          showToast("✏️ Une commande a été mise à jour" + tableInfo + ".", false);
          if (kanbanRefreshFn) kanbanRefreshFn();
        } else if (payload.type === "order_cancelled") {
          playNotificationSound("cancelled");
          showToast("🚫 Commande annulée par le client" + tableInfo + ".", false);
          var orderId = payload.data && payload.data.id;
          if (orderId && window.MFKanbanRefreshWithCancelAnimation) {
            window.MFKanbanRefreshWithCancelAnimation(orderId);
          } else if (kanbanRefreshFn) {
            kanbanRefreshFn();
          }
        } else if (kanbanRefreshFn) {
          kanbanRefreshFn();
        }
      };

      source.onerror = function () {
        setLiveStatus(false);
        source.close();
        setTimeout(connect, reconnectDelay);
        reconnectDelay = Math.min(reconnectDelay * 1.5, 15000);
      };
    }

    connect();
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var requestCancelConfirmation = initCancelOrderModal();

    initI18n();
    initToasts();
    initConfirmModal();
    initRestaurantSwitcherModal();
    initOrderCartAndMyOrders(requestCancelConfirmation);
    initCategoryNav();
    initOrderStatusPolling(requestCancelConfirmation);
    initReviewForm();
    initSortable();
    initKitchenPolling();
    initCopyButtons();
    initPaymentModal();
    initGlobalOrderWatcher();
    initThemeLiveSync();
  });
})();

==================== static/composition.js ====================
/* ==========================================================================
   MenuFlash Mini — composition des plats (tableau de bord et menu public).
   Toutes les données sont insérées via textContent : aucun HTML venant de
   la base n'est jamais interprété par le navigateur.
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var dataEl = document.getElementById("mf-composition-data");
  if (!dataEl) return;
  var data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent); } catch (e) { return; }
  var items = data.items || {};
  var labels = data.labels || {};

  function lang() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("mf_lang") === "en" ? "en" : "fr"; } catch (e) { return "fr"; }
  }
  function label(kind, key) {
    var entry = (labels[kind] || {})[key];
    return entry ? (entry[lang()] || entry.fr) : key;
  }
  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }
  function chip(kind, key) {
    var c = el("span", "mf-comp-chip mf-comp-chip--" + (kind === "allergens" ? "allergen" : "tag"));
    c.appendChild(el("i", "bi " + (kind === "allergens" ? "bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" : "bi-check2")));
    c.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label(kind, key)));
    return c;
  }
  function splitIngredients(raw) {
    var seen = {}, out = [];
    String(raw || "").split(/[\n\r,;]+/).forEach(function (part) {
      var t = part.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (t && !seen[t.toLowerCase()]) { seen[t.toLowerCase()] = 1; out.push(t); }
    });
    return out;
  }

  /* ----------------------------- Menu public ----------------------------- */
  function renderPublic() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-qty-group[data-item-id]").forEach(function (group) {
      var comp = items[group.dataset.itemId];
      var card = group.closest(".card-body");
      if (!card) return;
      var info = group.parentElement.querySelector(".flex-grow-1") || card;
      var box = info.querySelector(".mf-item-composition");
      if (box) box.remove();
      if (!comp) return;

      box = el("div", "mf-item-composition");
      if (comp.ingredients && comp.ingredients.length) {
        var p = el("p", "mf-comp-ingredients");
        p.appendChild(el("strong", null, ((labels.ui || {})[lang()] || {}).composition + " : "));
        p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(comp.ingredients.join(", ")));
        box.appendChild(p);
      }
      if ((comp.allergens || []).length || (comp.tags || []).length) {
        var chips = el("div", "mf-comp-chips");
        (comp.allergens || []).forEach(function (k) { chips.appendChild(chip("allergens", k)); });
        (comp.tags || []).forEach(function (k) { chips.appendChild(chip("tags", k)); });
        box.appendChild(chips);
      }
      info.appendChild(box);
    });
  }

  /* --------------------------- Tableau de bord --------------------------- */
  function renderAdmin() {
    var modalEl = document.getElementById("mf-composition-modal");
    var form = document.getElementById("mf-composition-form");
    if (!modalEl || !form) return;
    var textarea = document.getElementById("mf-composition-ingredients");
    var preview = document.getElementById("mf-composition-preview");
    var counter = document.getElementById("mf-composition-count");
    var nameEl = document.getElementById("mf-composition-name");

    function updatePreview() {
      var list = splitIngredients(textarea.value);
      counter.textContent = list.length;
      counter.parentElement.classList.toggle("text-danger", list.length > (data.max_ingredients || 30));
      preview.textContent = "";
      list.slice(0, 40).forEach(function (t) { preview.appendChild(el("span", "mf-comp-chip", t)); });
    }
    textarea.addEventListener("input", updatePreview);

    function open(itemId, itemName) {
      var comp = items[itemId] || { ingredients: [], allergens: [], tags: [] };
      form.action = "/admin/items/" + encodeURIComponent(itemId) + "/composition";
      nameEl.textContent = itemName || "";
      textarea.value = (comp.ingredients || []).join("\n");
      form.querySelectorAll('input[name="allergens"]').forEach(function (c) { c.checked = (comp.allergens || []).indexOf(c.value) !== -1; });
      form.querySelectorAll('input[name="tags"]').forEach(function (c) { c.checked = (comp.tags || []).indexOf(c.value) !== -1; });
      updatePreview();
      bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl).show();
    }

    // Ouvre la modale APRÈS la fermeture du menu d'actions (évite que les
    // deux composants Bootstrap se disputent le focus).
    function openFromMenu(trigger, id, name) {
      var dd = trigger.closest(".dropdown");
      var toggle = dd && dd.querySelector('[data-bs-toggle="dropdown"]');
      var inst = toggle && bootstrap.Dropdown.getInstance(toggle);
      if (inst && toggle.classList.contains("show")) {
        var done = false;
        var go = function () { if (!done) { done = true; open(id, name); } };
        toggle.addEventListener("hidden.bs.dropdown", go, { once: true });
        inst.hide();
        setTimeout(go, 300);
      } else {
        open(id, name);
      }
    }

    function summary(row, comp) {
      var info = row && row.querySelector(".mf-item-meta");
      if (!info || info.querySelector(".mf-comp-summary-pill")) return;
      var parts = [];
      if (comp.ingredients.length) parts.push(comp.ingredients.length + " ingrédient" + (comp.ingredients.length > 1 ? "s" : ""));
      if (comp.allergens.length) parts.push(comp.allergens.length + " allergène" + (comp.allergens.length > 1 ? "s" : ""));
      var pill = el("span", "mf-meta-pill mf-comp-summary-pill");
      pill.appendChild(el("i", "bi bi-list-check"));
      pill.appendChild(document.createTextNode(parts.join(" · ") || "Mentions renseignées"));
      info.insertBefore(pill, info.firstChild);
    }

    var menuItems = document.querySelectorAll(".mf-comp-open[data-item-id]");
    if (menuItems.length) {
      // Mise en page actuelle : entrée « Composition & allergènes » du menu d'actions.
      menuItems.forEach(function (item) {
        var id = item.dataset.itemId, name = item.dataset.itemName || "";
        var comp = items[id];
        item.addEventListener("click", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); openFromMenu(item, id, name); });
        if (comp) {
          item.classList.add("has-data");
          summary(item.closest("tr"), comp);
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    // Ancienne mise en page : bouton ajouté à côté du crayon de chaque plat.
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-edit-item-btn[data-item-id]").forEach(function (editBtn) {
      if (editBtn.parentElement.querySelector(".mf-comp-btn")) return;
      var id = editBtn.dataset.itemId, name = editBtn.dataset.itemName || "";
      var btn = el("button", "btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary border-0 mf-comp-btn" + (items[id] ? " has-data" : ""));
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.title = "Composition et allergènes";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Composition et allergènes de " + name);
      btn.appendChild(el("i", "bi bi-list-check"));
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () { open(id, name); });
      editBtn.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", btn);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (data.mode === "public") {
      renderPublic();
      document.querySelectorAll(".mf-lang-btn").forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(renderPublic, 0); });
      });
    } else if (data.mode === "admin") {
      renderAdmin();
    }
  });
})();

==================== static/file_upload.js ====================
/* ==========================================================================
   MenuFlash Mini — champ « Photo » compact (voir file_upload.css).
   - Bouton lisible « Photo » / « Fichier », puis nom du fichier + miniature.
   - Bouton × pour retirer le fichier choisi.
   - Contrôle immédiat du type et de la taille (5 Mo, comme le serveur) :
     évite d'envoyer un formulaire qui serait rejeté.
   Le serveur continue de tout vérifier (recompression de l'image, etc.).
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
  var counter = 0;

  function enhance(input) {
    if (input.dataset.mfFile === "1" || input.closest(".mf-file")) return;
    input.dataset.mfFile = "1";
    if (!input.id) input.id = "mf-file-" + (++counter);

    var isImage = /image/.test(input.getAttribute("accept") || "") || input.name === "photo" || input.name === "logo";
    var emptyText = isImage ? "Photo" : "Choisir un fichier";
    var small = input.classList.contains("form-control-sm");

    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "mf-file" + (small ? " mf-file--sm" : "");
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, input);
    wrap.appendChild(input);
    input.classList.remove("form-control", "form-control-sm");

    var btn = document.createElement("label");
    btn.className = "mf-file-btn";
    btn.htmlFor = input.id;
    btn.title = "Choisir " + (isImage ? "une photo (JPG, PNG ou WEBP, 5 Mo max.)" : "un fichier");
    var icon = document.createElement("i");
    icon.className = "bi " + (isImage ? "bi-camera" : "bi-paperclip");
    var name = document.createElement("span");
    name.className = "mf-file-name";
    name.textContent = emptyText;
    btn.appendChild(icon); btn.appendChild(name);
    wrap.appendChild(btn);

    var thumb = document.createElement("img");
    thumb.className = "mf-file-thumb"; thumb.alt = ""; thumb.hidden = true;
    wrap.appendChild(thumb);

    var clear = document.createElement("button");
    clear.type = "button"; clear.className = "mf-file-clear"; clear.hidden = true;
    clear.setAttribute("aria-label", "Retirer le fichier");
    clear.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i>';
    wrap.appendChild(clear);

    var error = document.createElement("div");
    error.className = "mf-file-error"; error.hidden = true; error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    wrap.appendChild(error);

    var url = null;
    function reset(message) {
      input.value = "";
      if (url) { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); url = null; }
      thumb.hidden = true; thumb.removeAttribute("src");
      clear.hidden = true;
      wrap.classList.remove("has-file");
      name.textContent = emptyText;
      icon.className = "bi " + (isImage ? "bi-camera" : "bi-paperclip");
      error.textContent = message || ""; error.hidden = !message;
    }

    input.addEventListener("change", function () {
      var f = input.files && input.files[0];
      if (!f) { reset(); return; }
      if (f.size > MAX_BYTES) { reset("Fichier trop lourd (" + (f.size / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " Mo) : 5 Mo maximum."); return; }
      if (isImage && !/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(f.type)) { reset("Format non accepté : JPG, PNG ou WEBP uniquement."); return; }
      error.hidden = true;
      wrap.classList.add("has-file");
      name.textContent = f.name;
      btn.title = f.name;
      icon.className = "bi bi-check-circle-fill";
      clear.hidden = false;
      if (isImage) {
        if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        url = URL.createObjectURL(f);
        thumb.src = url; thumb.hidden = false;
      }
    });
    clear.addEventListener("click", function () { reset(); input.focus(); });
    var form = input.form;
    if (form) form.addEventListener("reset", function () { setTimeout(function () { reset(); }, 0); });
  }

  function run(root) {
    (root || document).querySelectorAll('input[type="file"]').forEach(enhance);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { run(document); });
})();
