==================== static/forms_security.js ====================
/* ==========================================================================
   MenuFlash Mini — aide à la saisie sécurisée des formulaires (navigateur)

   Ce script AIDE l'utilisateur, il ne remplace pas les contrôles du serveur
   (security_forms.py), qui restent la seule vraie protection.

   - input[data-mf-password="new"]     : nouveau mot de passe -> liste des
     règles mise à jour en direct, blocage des espaces / ponctuation /
     accents à la frappe, message clair si collage d'un texte non autorisé.
   - input[data-mf-password="current"] : mot de passe existant -> seulement
     le bouton afficher/masquer et l'alerte majuscules.
   - input[data-mf-confirm="<id>"]     : confirmation, doit être identique.
   - form[data-mf-guard]               : empêche le double envoi.
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var MIN = 10, MAX = 64;
  var ALLOWED = /^[A-Za-z0-9]*$/;
  var RULES = [
    { key: "len",   label: MIN + " à " + MAX + " caractères",
      test: function (v) { return v.length >= MIN && v.length <= MAX; } },
    { key: "upper", label: "Une lettre majuscule", test: function (v) { return /[A-Z]/.test(v); } },
    { key: "lower", label: "Une lettre minuscule", test: function (v) { return /[a-z]/.test(v); } },
    { key: "digit", label: "Un chiffre",           test: function (v) { return /[0-9]/.test(v); } },
    { key: "chars", label: "Lettres sans accent et chiffres uniquement (ni espace, ni ponctuation)",
      test: function (v) { return v.length > 0 && ALLOWED.test(v); } }
  ];

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  function addToggle(input) {
    var wrap = el("div", "mf-pwd-wrap");
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, input);
    wrap.appendChild(input);
    var btn = el("button", "mf-pwd-toggle");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Afficher le mot de passe");
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-eye"></i>';
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var show = input.type === "password";
      input.type = show ? "text" : "password";
      btn.innerHTML = show ? '<i class="bi bi-eye-slash"></i>' : '<i class="bi bi-eye"></i>';
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", show ? "Masquer le mot de passe" : "Afficher le mot de passe");
      input.focus();
    });
    wrap.appendChild(btn);
    return wrap;
  }

  function addCapsWarning(input, after) {
    var warn = el("div", "mf-caps-warning d-none", "Attention : la touche Verr. Maj est activée.");
    after.parentNode.insertBefore(warn, after.nextSibling);
    function check(e) {
      if (e.getModifierState) warn.classList.toggle("d-none", !e.getModifierState("CapsLock"));
    }
    input.addEventListener("keydown", check);
    input.addEventListener("keyup", check);
    input.addEventListener("blur", function () { warn.classList.add("d-none"); });
    return warn;
  }

  function setupNewPassword(input, wrap, after) {
    var list = el("ul", "mf-pwd-rules");
    list.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    var items = {};
    RULES.forEach(function (r) {
      var li = el("li", "", r.label);
      items[r.key] = li;
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
    var hint = el("div", "mf-pwd-hint d-none");
    after.parentNode.insertBefore(list, after.nextSibling);
    list.parentNode.insertBefore(hint, list);

    function showHint(text) {
      hint.textContent = text;
      hint.classList.remove("d-none");
      clearTimeout(hint._t);
      hint._t = setTimeout(function () { hint.classList.add("d-none"); }, 3500);
    }

    // Bloque à la frappe les caractères non autorisés.
    input.addEventListener("beforeinput", function (e) {
      if (e.inputType === "insertText" && e.data && !ALLOWED.test(e.data)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showHint("Caractère « " + e.data + " » non autorisé : uniquement des lettres sans accent et des chiffres.");
      }
    });

    function update() {
      var v = input.value;
      var allOk = true;
      RULES.forEach(function (r) {
        var ok = r.test(v);
        items[r.key].classList.toggle("ok", ok);
        if (!ok) allOk = false;
      });
      input.setCustomValidity(allOk || v === "" ? "" :
        "Le mot de passe ne respecte pas toutes les règles affichées.");
      if (v && !ALLOWED.test(v)) {
        showHint("Le texte contient des espaces, de la ponctuation ou des accents, qui ne sont pas autorisés.");
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-mf-confirm="' + input.id + '"]').forEach(function (c) {
        c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
      });
    }
    input.addEventListener("input", update);
    update();
  }

  function setupConfirm(confirm) {
    var target = document.getElementById(confirm.getAttribute("data-mf-confirm"));
    if (!target) return;
    var msg = el("div", "mf-confirm-msg d-none", "Les deux mots de passe ne correspondent pas.");
    var anchor = confirm.closest(".mf-pwd-wrap") || confirm;
    anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(msg, anchor.nextSibling);
    confirm.addEventListener("input", function () {
      var mismatch = confirm.value !== "" && confirm.value !== target.value;
      confirm.setCustomValidity(mismatch ? "Les deux mots de passe ne correspondent pas." : "");
      msg.classList.toggle("d-none", !mismatch);
    });
  }

  function setupNoDoubleSubmit(form) {
    form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      if (form.dataset.mfSubmitting === "1") { e.preventDefault(); return; }
      if (typeof form.checkValidity === "function" && !form.checkValidity()) return;
      form.dataset.mfSubmitting = "1";
      form.querySelectorAll('button[type="submit"]').forEach(function (b) {
        b.disabled = true;
        b.dataset.mfLabel = b.innerHTML;
        b.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm me-1"></span>Envoi…';
      });
      // Si l'utilisateur revient sur la page (bouton retour), on réactive.
      setTimeout(function () {
        form.dataset.mfSubmitting = "0";
        form.querySelectorAll('button[type="submit"]').forEach(function (b) {
          b.disabled = false;
          if (b.dataset.mfLabel) b.innerHTML = b.dataset.mfLabel;
        });
      }, 15000);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    document.querySelectorAll("input[data-mf-password]").forEach(function (input) {
      input.setAttribute("autocapitalize", "off");
      input.setAttribute("autocorrect", "off");
      input.setAttribute("spellcheck", "false");
      var wrap = addToggle(input);
      var warn = addCapsWarning(input, wrap);
      if (input.getAttribute("data-mf-password") === "new") setupNewPassword(input, wrap, warn);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("input[data-mf-confirm]").forEach(setupConfirm);
    document.querySelectorAll("form[data-mf-guard]").forEach(setupNoDoubleSubmit);
  });
})();

==================== static/menu_admin.js ====================
/* ==========================================================================
   MenuFlash Mini — gestion du menu (tableau de bord du restaurateur)

   - Recherche instantanée (nom + description, sans tenir compte des accents)
   - Filtres : Tous / Épuisés / À compléter (photo, description, composition)
   - Catégories repliables (état mémorisé par restaurant)
   - « Afficher les N autres plats » au-delà de 8 plats par catégorie
   - Interrupteur Disponible / Épuisé sans rechargement de la page
   - Rappel des plats incomplets
   - Info-bulles sur les boutons icône, catégorie présélectionnée à l'ajout

   Toutes les données affichées passent par textContent (aucune injection HTML).
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var VISIBLE_ROWS = 8;        // plats affichés par catégorie avant « Afficher plus »
  var MORE_THRESHOLD = 10;     // « Afficher plus » seulement au-delà de ce nombre

  function norm(text) {
    return String(text || "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().trim();
  }
  function toast(msg, isError) { if (window.MFShowToast) window.MFShowToast(msg, !!isError); }
  function plural(n, one, many) { return n + " " + (n > 1 ? many : one); }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var list = document.getElementById("categories-list");
    if (!list) return;

    var blocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll(".mf-category-block"));
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll("tr.mf-item-row"));
    var search = document.getElementById("mf-menu-search");
    var result = document.getElementById("mf-search-result");
    var noResults = document.getElementById("mf-no-results");
    var noResultsText = document.getElementById("mf-no-results-text");
    var state = { query: "", filter: "all", expanded: {} };

    /* ---------------- Info-bulles ---------------- */
    if (window.bootstrap && bootstrap.Tooltip) {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-mf-tip]").forEach(function (el) {
        el.setAttribute("title", el.dataset.mfTip);
        new bootstrap.Tooltip(el, { trigger: "hover", container: "body" });
      });
    }

    /* ---------------- Plats incomplets ---------------- */
    var compItems = {};
    try {
      var compEl = document.getElementById("mf-composition-data");
      if (compEl) compItems = JSON.parse(compEl.textContent).items || {};
    } catch (e) { compItems = {}; }

    var missingCount = { photo: 0, desc: 0, comp: 0 };
    var incompleteTotal = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var missing = [];
      if (row.dataset.hasPhoto !== "1") { missing.push("photo"); missingCount.photo++; }
      if (row.dataset.hasDesc !== "1") { missing.push("description"); missingCount.desc++; }
      if (!compItems[row.dataset.id]) { missing.push("composition"); missingCount.comp++; }
      row.dataset.incomplete = missing.length ? "1" : "0";
      // Le texte de recherche sans accents est préparé une seule fois.
      row.dataset.searchNorm = norm(row.dataset.search);
      if (missing.length) {
        incompleteTotal++;
        var pill = row.querySelector("[data-mf-incomplete]");
        if (pill) {
          pill.textContent = "";
          var icon = document.createElement("i");
          icon.className = "bi bi-exclamation-circle";
          pill.appendChild(icon);
          pill.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Sans " + missing.join(", ")));
          pill.classList.remove("d-none");
        }
      }
    });

    var incCount = document.getElementById("mf-count-incomplete");
    if (incCount) incCount.textContent = incompleteTotal;
    var tip = document.getElementById("mf-incomplete-tip");
    if (tip && incompleteTotal && rows.length) {
      document.getElementById("mf-incomplete-title").textContent =
        plural(incompleteTotal, "plat peut", "plats peuvent") + " être amélioré" + (incompleteTotal > 1 ? "s" : "");
      var parts = [];
      if (missingCount.photo) parts.push(plural(missingCount.photo, "sans photo", "sans photo"));
      if (missingCount.desc) parts.push(plural(missingCount.desc, "sans description", "sans description"));
      if (missingCount.comp) parts.push(plural(missingCount.comp, "sans composition", "sans composition"));
      document.getElementById("mf-incomplete-detail").textContent =
        parts.join(" · ") + ". Un menu complet rassure les clients et fait vendre davantage.";
      tip.classList.remove("d-none");
    }

    /* ---------------- Repli des catégories ---------------- */
    var storeKey = "mf_collapsed_" + (list.dataset.restaurant || "0");
    var collapsed = {};
    try { collapsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeKey) || "{}") || {}; } catch (e) { collapsed = {}; }

    function saveCollapsed() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify(collapsed)); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function setCollapsed(block, value) {
      block.classList.toggle("is-collapsed", value);
      var btn = block.querySelector(".mf-cat-toggle");
      if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", value ? "false" : "true");
      if (value) collapsed[block.dataset.id] = 1; else delete collapsed[block.dataset.id];
    }
    blocks.forEach(function (block) {
      if (collapsed[block.dataset.id]) setCollapsed(block, true);
      var btn = block.querySelector(".mf-cat-toggle");
      if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setCollapsed(block, !block.classList.contains("is-collapsed"));
        saveCollapsed();
        updateToggleAll();
      });
    });

    var toggleAll = document.getElementById("mf-toggle-all");
    function updateToggleAll() {
      if (!toggleAll) return;
      var allCollapsed = blocks.length && blocks.every(function (b) { return b.classList.contains("is-collapsed"); });
      toggleAll.querySelector("span").textContent = allCollapsed ? "Tout déplier" : "Tout replier";
      toggleAll.querySelector("i").className = "bi " + (allCollapsed ? "bi-arrows-expand" : "bi-arrows-collapse") + " me-1";
    }
    if (toggleAll) {
      toggleAll.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var collapse = !blocks.every(function (b) { return b.classList.contains("is-collapsed"); });
        blocks.forEach(function (b) { setCollapsed(b, collapse); });
        saveCollapsed();
        updateToggleAll();
      });
      updateToggleAll();
    }

    /* ---------------- Filtrage, recherche et « Afficher plus » ---------------- */
    function matches(row) {
      if (state.query && row.dataset.searchNorm.indexOf(state.query) === -1) return false;
      if (state.filter === "soldout" && !row.classList.contains("is-soldout")) return false;
      if (state.filter === "incomplete" && row.dataset.incomplete !== "1") return false;
      return true;
    }

    function apply() {
      var filtering = !!state.query || state.filter !== "all";
      list.classList.toggle("mf-filtering", filtering);
      var shown = 0;

      blocks.forEach(function (block) {
        var blockRows = Array.prototype.slice.call(block.querySelectorAll("tr.mf-item-row"));
        var visible = 0;
        blockRows.forEach(function (row) {
          var ok = matches(row);
          row.classList.toggle("d-none", !ok);
          row.classList.remove("mf-row-more");
          if (ok) visible++;
        });
        shown += visible;

        // Pendant une recherche, on cache les catégories sans résultat.
        block.classList.toggle("d-none", filtering && visible === 0);

        // « Afficher plus » : seulement hors recherche/filtre.
        var more = block.querySelector(".mf-show-more");
        if (!more) return;
        var hiddenRows = [];
        if (!filtering && blockRows.length > MORE_THRESHOLD && !state.expanded[block.dataset.id]) {
          hiddenRows = blockRows.slice(VISIBLE_ROWS);
          hiddenRows.forEach(function (row) { row.classList.add("mf-row-more"); });
        }
        more.classList.toggle("d-none", hiddenRows.length === 0);
        if (hiddenRows.length) {
          more.querySelector("button").textContent = "Afficher les " + hiddenRows.length + " autres plats";
        }
      });

      if (result) {
        result.classList.toggle("d-none", !filtering || shown === 0);
        result.textContent = filtering ? plural(shown, "plat trouvé", "plats trouvés") : "";
      }
      if (noResults) {
        noResults.classList.toggle("d-none", !(filtering && shown === 0));
        noResultsText.textContent = state.query
          ? "Aucun plat ne correspond à « " + search.value.trim() + " »."
          : "Aucun plat dans ce filtre.";
      }
    }

    blocks.forEach(function (block) {
      var more = block.querySelector(".mf-show-more button");
      if (more) more.addEventListener("click", function () {
        state.expanded[block.dataset.id] = true;
        apply();
      });
    });

    if (search) {
      var timer = null;
      search.addEventListener("input", function () {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(function () { state.query = norm(search.value); apply(); }, 120);
      });
      search.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Escape") { search.value = ""; state.query = ""; apply(); }
      });
      // Raccourci « / » pour aller dans la recherche.
      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        var tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) || "";
        if (e.key === "/" && !/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(tag) && !document.querySelector(".modal.show")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          search.focus();
        }
      });
    }

    function setFilter(value) {
      state.filter = value;
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-mf-filter]").forEach(function (chip) {
        chip.classList.toggle("is-active", chip.dataset.mfFilter === value);
        chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", chip.dataset.mfFilter === value ? "true" : "false");
      });
      apply();
    }
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-mf-filter]").forEach(function (chip) {
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () { setFilter(chip.dataset.mfFilter); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-mf-filter-shortcut]").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setFilter(btn.dataset.mfFilterShortcut);
        var toolbar = document.querySelector(".mf-menu-toolbar");
        if (toolbar) toolbar.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      });
    });
    var clear = document.getElementById("mf-clear-filters");
    if (clear) clear.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (search) search.value = "";
      state.query = "";
      setFilter("all");
    });

    /* ---------------- Disponible / Épuisé sans rechargement ---------------- */
    var soldoutCount = document.getElementById("mf-count-soldout");
    function refreshSoldoutCount() {
      if (soldoutCount) soldoutCount.textContent = list.querySelectorAll("tr.mf-item-row.is-soldout").length;
    }
    function renderAvailability(row, available) {
      var input = row.querySelector(".mf-avail-switch");
      var label = row.querySelector(".mf-avail-label");
      if (input) input.checked = available;
      if (label) label.textContent = available ? "Disponible" : "Épuisé";
      row.classList.toggle("is-soldout", !available);
      refreshSoldoutCount();
    }

    list.querySelectorAll(".mf-avail-form").forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector(".mf-avail-switch");
      var row = form.closest("tr");
      if (!input || !row) return;
      form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
      input.addEventListener("change", function () {
        var wanted = input.checked;
        input.disabled = true;
        renderAvailability(row, wanted);
        fetch(form.action, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" },
          body: new FormData(form)
        })
          .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
          .then(function (data) {
            renderAvailability(row, !!data.is_available);
            var name = (row.querySelector(".mf-item-name") || {}).textContent || "Plat";
            toast(name + (data.is_available ? " est de nouveau disponible." : " est marqué épuisé : il est masqué aux clients."), false);
            if (state.filter === "soldout") apply();
          })
          .catch(function () {
            renderAvailability(row, !wanted);
            toast("Impossible de changer la disponibilité. Vérifiez votre connexion.", true);
          })
          .finally(function () { input.disabled = false; });
      });
    });

    /* ---------------- Ajout d'un plat : catégorie présélectionnée ---------------- */
    var addModal = document.getElementById("mf-add-item-modal");
    if (addModal) {
      addModal.addEventListener("show.bs.modal", function (e) {
        var trigger = e.relatedTarget;
        var select = document.getElementById("add-item-category");
        if (trigger && trigger.dataset.categoryId && select) select.value = trigger.dataset.categoryId;
      });
      addModal.addEventListener("shown.bs.modal", function () {
        var name = document.getElementById("add-item-name");
        if (name) name.focus();
      });
    }
    var addCat = document.getElementById("mf-add-category-modal");
    if (addCat) addCat.addEventListener("shown.bs.modal", function () {
      var input = document.getElementById("add-category-name");
      if (input) input.focus();
    });

    apply();
  });
})();

==================== static/menu_public.js ====================
/* ==========================================================================
   MenuFlash Mini — menu client : recherche, « Les plus commandés »,
   « Voir les autres plats » et badge « Populaire ».

   - Le bouton + d'un plat populaire déclenche le vrai bouton + du plat dans
     le menu : le panier, le récapitulatif et les suggestions fonctionnent
     exactement comme d'habitude (aucune logique de commande dupliquée).
   - Textes en français ou en anglais selon la langue choisie par le client.
   - Tout le contenu est inséré par textContent (aucune injection HTML).
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var VISIBLE_ITEMS = 6;       // plats affichés par catégorie avant « Voir plus »
  var MORE_THRESHOLD = 8;      // « Voir plus » seulement au-delà de ce nombre

  var TEXT = {
    fr: { search: "Rechercher un plat…", popular: "Les plus commandés", badge: "Populaire",
          more: function (n) { return "Voir les " + n + " autres plats"; },
          none: function (q) { return "Aucun plat ne correspond à « " + q + " »."; },
          add: function (name) { return "Ajouter " + name; }, clear: "Effacer la recherche" },
    en: { search: "Search a dish…", popular: "Most ordered", badge: "Popular",
          more: function (n) { return "See " + n + " more dishes"; },
          none: function (q) { return "No dish matches “" + q + "”."; },
          add: function (name) { return "Add " + name; }, clear: "Clear search" }
  };
  function lang() { try { return localStorage.getItem("mf_lang") === "en" ? "en" : "fr"; } catch (e) { return "fr"; } }
  function t(key) { return TEXT[lang()][key]; }
  function norm(text) {
    return String(text || "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().trim();
  }
  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var form = document.getElementById("order-form");
    if (!form) return;

    var sections = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".mf-menu-section"));
    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".mf-item-card[data-mf-item]"));
    cards.forEach(function (card) { card.dataset.searchNorm = norm(card.dataset.search); });

    var search = document.getElementById("mf-pub-search");
    var clearBtn = document.querySelector(".mf-pub-search-clear");
    var noResult = document.getElementById("mf-pub-noresult");
    var popular = document.getElementById("mf-popular");
    var track = document.getElementById("mf-popular-track");
    var expanded = {};
    var query = "";

    function cardById(id) { return document.querySelector('.mf-item-card[data-mf-item="' + id + '"]'); }

    /* ---------------- « Les plus commandés » ---------------- */
    var popularIds = [];
    try { popularIds = JSON.parse((document.getElementById("mf-popular-data") || {}).textContent || "[]"); }
    catch (e) { popularIds = []; }
    var popularTiles = [];

    function buildPopular() {
      if (!popular || !track || !popularIds.length) return;
      popularIds.forEach(function (id) {
        var card = cardById(id);
        if (!card) return;
        var group = card.querySelector(".mf-qty-group");
        var plus = card.querySelector(".mf-qty-plus");
        var nameText = (card.querySelector("h3") || {}).textContent || "";
        var priceText = (card.querySelector(".mf-item-price") || {}).textContent || "";

        // Badge « Populaire » sur le plat dans le menu.
        var title = card.querySelector("h3");
        if (title && !title.querySelector(".mf-pop-badge")) {
          title.appendChild(el("span", "mf-pop-badge", t("badge")));
        }

        var tile = el("div", "mf-pop-tile");
        tile.setAttribute("role", "button");
        tile.tabIndex = 0;
        var img = card.querySelector("img.mf-item-img");
        var media = el("div", "mf-pop-media");
        if (img) {
          var i = document.createElement("img");
          i.src = img.getAttribute("src");
          i.alt = "";
          i.loading = "lazy";
          media.appendChild(i);
        } else {
          media.appendChild(el("i", "bi bi-egg-fried"));
        }
        var qty = el("span", "mf-pop-qty d-none");
        media.appendChild(qty);
        tile.appendChild(media);
        tile.appendChild(el("div", "mf-pop-name", nameText.replace(t("badge"), "").trim()));
        var foot = el("div", "mf-pop-foot");
        foot.appendChild(el("span", "mf-pop-price", priceText.trim()));
        var add = el("button", "mf-pop-add");
        add.type = "button";
        add.setAttribute("aria-label", t("add")(nameText.trim()));
        add.appendChild(el("i", "bi bi-plus-lg"));
        foot.appendChild(add);
        tile.appendChild(foot);
        track.appendChild(tile);

        function syncQty() {
          var v = parseInt(((group && group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value")) || {}).textContent, 10) || 0;
          qty.textContent = v;
          qty.classList.toggle("d-none", v === 0);
        }
        add.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (plus) plus.click();
          syncQty();
          add.classList.remove("mf-pop");
          void add.offsetWidth;
          add.classList.add("mf-pop");
        });
        function goToCard() {
          card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
          card.classList.remove("mf-highlight");
          void card.offsetWidth;
          card.classList.add("mf-highlight");
        }
        tile.addEventListener("click", goToCard);
        tile.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); goToCard(); } });
        // La tuile suit en permanence la quantité du plat dans le menu (ajout,
        // retrait, panier vidé après l'envoi de la commande…).
        var valueEl = group && group.querySelector(".mf-qty-value");
        if (valueEl && window.MutationObserver) {
          new MutationObserver(syncQty).observe(valueEl, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
        }
        popularTiles.push({ syncQty: syncQty, add: add, name: nameText.trim() });
      });
      if (popularTiles.length) popular.classList.remove("d-none");
    }

    /* ---------------- « Voir les autres plats » ---------------- */
    function setupMore(section) {
      var list = Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll(".mf-item-card[data-mf-item]"));
      if (list.length <= MORE_THRESHOLD) return;
      var btn = el("button", "btn mf-pub-more");
      btn.type = "button";
      section.appendChild(btn);
      section._more = { cards: list.slice(VISIBLE_ITEMS), btn: btn };
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        expanded[section.id] = true;
        apply();
      });
    }

    /* ---------------- Recherche et affichage ---------------- */
    function apply() {
      var searching = !!query;
      var shown = 0;
      sections.forEach(function (section) {
        var visible = 0;
        section.querySelectorAll(".mf-item-card[data-mf-item]").forEach(function (card) {
          var ok = !searching || card.dataset.searchNorm.indexOf(query) !== -1;
          card.classList.toggle("d-none", !ok);
          card.classList.remove("mf-pub-hidden");
          if (ok) visible++;
        });
        shown += visible;
        section.classList.toggle("d-none", searching && visible === 0);
        var more = section._more;
        if (more) {
          var collapse = !searching && !expanded[section.id];
          more.cards.forEach(function (card) { card.classList.toggle("mf-pub-hidden", collapse); });
          more.btn.classList.toggle("d-none", !collapse);
          more.btn.textContent = t("more")(more.cards.length);
        }
      });
      if (popular && popularTiles.length) popular.classList.toggle("d-none", searching);
      if (noResult) {
        noResult.classList.toggle("d-none", !(searching && shown === 0));
        noResult.textContent = searching ? t("none")(search.value.trim()) : "";
      }
      if (clearBtn) clearBtn.classList.toggle("d-none", !searching);
    }

    function translate() {
      if (search) search.placeholder = t("search");
      if (clearBtn) clearBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", t("clear"));
      var title = document.querySelector("#mf-popular-title span");
      if (title) title.textContent = t("popular");
      document.querySelectorAll(".mf-pop-badge").forEach(function (b) { b.textContent = t("badge"); });
      popularTiles.forEach(function (p) { p.add.setAttribute("aria-label", t("add")(p.name)); });
      apply();
    }

    if (search) {
      var timer = null;
      search.addEventListener("input", function () {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(function () { query = norm(search.value); apply(); }, 120);
      });
      search.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); search.blur(); }
        if (e.key === "Escape") { search.value = ""; query = ""; apply(); }
      });
    }
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      search.value = ""; query = ""; apply(); search.focus();
    });

    // Un clic sur une catégorie annule la recherche pour afficher tout le menu.
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-nav-pills .nav-link").forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (query) { search.value = ""; query = ""; apply(); }
      });
    });

    buildPopular();
    sections.forEach(setupMore);
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-lang-btn").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(translate, 0); });
    });
    translate();
  });
})();

==================== static/order_edit.js ====================
/*
 * MenuFlash Mini — « Modifier la commande » (menu client).
 *
 * UN SEUL bouton « Modifier la commande », sur chaque carte de « Mes commandes » qui peut encore
 * être modifiée et sur la page de suivi d'une commande « Nouvelle ». Il ouvre une fenêtre :
 *   − / +       change la quantité d'un plat
 *   Retirer     enlève le plat (confirmation en deux temps)
 *   Ajouter d'autres plats   ouvre le menu en mode ajout (parcours « Ajouter des plats » existant)
 * Le serveur (order_edit.py) revérifie tout : propriétaire, statut, dernier plat, disponibilité.
 *
 * Script autonome : il ne dépend pas du contenu d'app.js, seulement de la structure des cartes
 * (.mf-myorder-card, .mf-myorder-actions, .mf-cancel-order-trigger, .mf-addto-btn) et de la page
 * de suivi (#order-status-root, #cancel-order-btn). L'ancien bouton « Ajouter des plats » des
 * cartes est masqué (il est conservé dans la page : « Ajouter d'autres plats » le déclenche).
 * Français et anglais intégrés.
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  if (window.__mfOrderEditLoaded) return;
  window.__mfOrderEditLoaded = true;

  var MAX_QTY = 50;
  var TEXT = {
    fr: {
      btn: "Modifier la commande", title: "Modifier ma commande",
      help: "Changez les quantités, retirez un plat ou ajoutez-en d'autres.",
      remove: "Retirer", confirm: "Confirmer ?", minus: "Une unité de moins : {name}", plus: "Une unité de plus : {name}",
      done: "Terminé", loading: "Chargement…", total: "Nouveau total", each: "{price} l'unité",
      addMore: "Ajouter d'autres plats", added: "{qty} × {name} ajouté.", removed: "{qty} × {name} retiré de votre commande.",
      last: "C'est le dernier plat de votre commande. Pour le retirer, annulez la commande.", cancel: "Annuler la commande",
      locked: "Trop tard : la cuisine a déjà commencé la préparation.", stale: "La commande a changé : la liste a été mise à jour.",
      error: "Impossible de modifier la commande. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.",
      notmine: "Cette commande n'a pas été passée depuis cet appareil.",
      noAdd: "Impossible d'ouvrir le menu pour ajouter des plats. Commandez ces plats dans une nouvelle commande."
    },
    en: {
      btn: "Edit order", title: "Edit my order",
      help: "Change quantities, remove an item or add more.",
      remove: "Remove", confirm: "Confirm?", minus: "One less: {name}", plus: "One more: {name}",
      done: "Done", loading: "Loading…", total: "New total", each: "{price} each",
      addMore: "Add more items", added: "{qty} × {name} added.", removed: "{qty} × {name} removed from your order.",
      last: "This is the last item of your order. To remove it, cancel the order.", cancel: "Cancel the order",
      locked: "Too late: the kitchen has already started preparing it.", stale: "The order changed: the list was updated.",
      error: "Could not change the order. Check your connection and try again.",
      notmine: "This order was not placed from this device.",
      noAdd: "Could not open the menu to add items. Please place these items as a new order."
    }
  };

  function lang() {
    var b = document.querySelector(".mf-lang-btn.active");
    var l = b && b.getAttribute("data-lang");
    if (l === "fr" || l === "en") return l;
    return ((document.documentElement.lang || "fr").slice(0, 2) === "en") ? "en" : "fr";
  }
  function t(key, vars) {
    var s = (TEXT[lang()] || TEXT.fr)[key] || TEXT.fr[key] || key;
    Object.keys(vars || {}).forEach(function (k) { s = s.split("{" + k + "}").join(vars[k]); });
    return s;
  }
  function pathSlug() {
    var m = location.pathname.match(/^\/m\/([^\/]+)/);
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
  }
  function slug() {
    var f = document.getElementById("order-form");
    return (f && f.getAttribute("data-slug")) || pathSlug();
  }
  function currency() {
    var f = document.getElementById("order-form");
    return (f && f.getAttribute("data-currency")) || "";
  }
  function csrf() {
    var m = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
    return m ? m.getAttribute("content") : "";
  }
  function money(n) {
    var s;
    try { s = new Intl.NumberFormat(lang() === "en" ? "en-US" : "fr-FR").format(n); } catch (e) { s = String(n); }
    return currency() ? s + " " + currency() : s;
  }
  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;          // textContent : jamais de HTML venant du menu
    return e;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ API */
  function api(orderId, path, body) {
    var url = "/m/" + encodeURIComponent(slug()) + "/commande/" + orderId + path;
    var opts = { cache: "no-store", headers: { "X-Requested-With": "fetch" } };
    if (body) {
      opts.method = "POST";
      opts.headers["X-CSRFToken"] = csrf();
      var fd = new URLSearchParams();
      Object.keys(body).forEach(function (k) { fd.append(k, body[k]); });
      opts.body = fd;
      opts.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
    }
    return fetch(url, opts).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (d) {
        d.__status = r.status;
        // Cette commande n'est pas (ou plus) la sienne : le serveur indique la page où ramener le client.
        // On y va sans rien afficher ; la promesse ne se termine pas pour qu'aucune erreur ne s'affiche.
        if (d && typeof d.redirect === "string" && /^\/(?![\/\\])/.test(d.redirect)) {   // adresse du site seulement
          window.location.replace(d.redirect);
          return new Promise(function () {});
        }
        return d;
      });
    });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ petit message hors fenêtre */
  function flash(message) {
    var box = el("div", "alert alert-warning shadow-sm mf-oe-flash", message);
    box.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    setTimeout(function () { box.remove(); }, 6000);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ fenêtre */
  var CSS = ".mf-oe-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--mf-border,#E7E4DD)}" +
    ".mf-oe-info{min-width:0;flex:1 1 140px}.mf-oe-name{font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}" +
    ".mf-oe-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}" +
    ".mf-oe-step{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;border:1px solid var(--mf-border,#E7E4DD);border-radius:999px;padding:2px}" +
    ".mf-oe-step .btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1}" +
    ".mf-oe-qty{min-width:30px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}" +
    ".mf-oe-remove{min-height:40px}.mf-oe-total{font-weight:700;color:var(--mf-accent-dark,#B5730F)}" +
    ".mf-oe-more{margin-top:12px}.mf-oe-last{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--mf-bg,#F7F6F3)}" +
    ".mf-myorder-actions .mf-myorder-addbtn{display:none!important}" +
    ".mf-oe-flash{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:2000;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}" +
    "@media (max-width:575.98px){.mf-oe-modal .modal-dialog{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;margin:0;max-width:none;" +
    "transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .25s ease-out}.mf-oe-modal.show .modal-dialog{transform:none}" +
    ".mf-oe-modal .modal-content{border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;max-height:92vh}.mf-oe-modal .modal-footer{padding-bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}}";

  var modalEl = null, modal = null, state = null;

  function injectCss() {
    if (document.getElementById("mf-oe-style")) return;
    var st = document.createElement("style");
    st.id = "mf-oe-style"; st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  function ensureModal() {
    if (modalEl) return;
    injectCss();
    modalEl = el("div", "modal fade mf-oe-modal");
    modalEl.tabIndex = -1;
    modalEl.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    modalEl.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "mf-oe-title");
    var dialog = el("div", "modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-dialog-scrollable");
    var content = el("div", "modal-content");
    var head = el("div", "modal-header border-0 pb-1");
    var titleBox = el("div");
    var title = el("h5", "modal-title", "");
    title.id = "mf-oe-title";
    var help = el("div", "small text-secondary", "");
    help.setAttribute("data-oe", "help");
    titleBox.appendChild(title); titleBox.appendChild(help);
    var closeX = el("button", "btn-close");
    closeX.type = "button";
    closeX.setAttribute("data-bs-dismiss", "modal");
    head.appendChild(titleBox); head.appendChild(closeX);
    var body = el("div", "modal-body pt-2");
    var notice = el("div", "small mb-2 d-none");
    notice.setAttribute("role", "status");
    notice.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    notice.setAttribute("data-oe", "notice");
    var list = el("div", "mf-oe-list");
    list.setAttribute("data-oe", "list");
    var more = el("button", "btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mf-oe-more");
    more.type = "button";
    more.setAttribute("data-oe", "more");
    more.addEventListener("click", function () { addMore(); });
    var foot = el("div", "modal-footer border-0 d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center");
    var total = el("div", "mf-oe-total");
    total.setAttribute("data-oe", "total");
    var close = el("button", "btn btn-primary");
    close.type = "button";
    close.setAttribute("data-bs-dismiss", "modal");
    close.setAttribute("data-oe", "close");
    foot.appendChild(total); foot.appendChild(close);
    body.appendChild(notice); body.appendChild(list); body.appendChild(more);
    content.appendChild(head); content.appendChild(body); content.appendChild(foot);
    dialog.appendChild(content); modalEl.appendChild(dialog);
    document.body.appendChild(modalEl);
    modal = bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl);
    // Le focus doit entrer dans la fenêtre (clavier, lecteur d'écran, touche Échap), même ouverte
    // depuis le panneau « Mes commandes » qui a son propre piège à focus.
    modalEl.addEventListener("shown.bs.modal", function () { modalEl.focus(); });
    modalEl.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", function () {
      if (state && state.changed && state.onChanged) state.onChanged();
      state = null;
    });
  }
  function q(name) { return modalEl.querySelector('[data-oe="' + name + '"]'); }

  function setNotice(message, kind) {
    var n = q("notice");
    n.textContent = message || "";
    n.className = "small mb-2 " + (message ? "alert py-2 alert-" + (kind || "success") : "d-none");
  }

  function render() {
    modalEl.querySelector(".modal-title").textContent = t("title");
    q("help").textContent = t("help");
    q("close").textContent = t("done");
    q("more").textContent = "";
    var plusIcon = el("i", "bi bi-plus-lg me-1"); plusIcon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    q("more").appendChild(plusIcon); q("more").appendChild(document.createTextNode(t("addMore")));
    q("more").classList.toggle("d-none", !state || !state.lines || !state.lines.length);
    q("more").disabled = !!(state && state.busy);
    var list = q("list");
    list.textContent = "";
    if (!state || !state.lines) { list.appendChild(el("p", "text-secondary small mb-0", t("loading"))); return; }
    var onlyOne = state.lines.length <= 1;
    state.lines.forEach(function (line) {
      var row = el("div", "mf-oe-row");
      row.setAttribute("data-line-id", line.id);
      var info = el("div", "mf-oe-info");
      info.appendChild(el("div", "mf-oe-name", line.name));
      info.appendChild(el("div", "small text-secondary", t("each", { price: money(line.price) })));
      var actions = el("div", "mf-oe-actions");
      var step = el("div", "mf-oe-step");
      var minus = el("button", "btn btn-light mf-oe-minus", "−");
      minus.type = "button";
      minus.disabled = line.quantity <= 1;                       // à 1 : « Retirer » (ou annuler s'il n'y a plus que ce plat)
      minus.setAttribute("aria-label", t("minus", { name: line.name }));
      minus.addEventListener("click", function () { changeLine(line, line.quantity - 1); });
      var qty = el("span", "mf-oe-qty", String(line.quantity));
      qty.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
      var plus = el("button", "btn btn-light mf-oe-plus", "+");
      plus.type = "button";
      plus.disabled = !line.can_increase || line.quantity >= MAX_QTY;
      plus.setAttribute("aria-label", t("plus", { name: line.name }));
      plus.addEventListener("click", function () { changeLine(line, line.quantity + 1); });
      step.appendChild(minus); step.appendChild(qty); step.appendChild(plus);
      actions.appendChild(step);
      if (!onlyOne) {
        var rm = el("button", "btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm mf-oe-remove", t("remove"));
        rm.type = "button";
        var armed = null;
        rm.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (!armed) {                                            // 1er appui : on demande confirmation
            rm.textContent = t("confirm");
            rm.classList.remove("btn-outline-danger"); rm.classList.add("btn-danger");
            armed = setTimeout(function () {
              armed = null; rm.textContent = t("remove");
              rm.classList.add("btn-outline-danger"); rm.classList.remove("btn-danger");
            }, 4000);
            return;
          }
          clearTimeout(armed); armed = null;
          changeLine(line, 0);
        });
        actions.appendChild(rm);
      }
      row.appendChild(info); row.appendChild(actions);
      list.appendChild(row);
    });
    if (onlyOne) {                                                 // dernier plat : seule l'annulation le retire
      var last = el("div", "mf-oe-last small mt-2");
      last.appendChild(el("div", "text-secondary mb-2", t("last")));
      var cancel = el("button", "btn btn-danger btn-sm", t("cancel"));
      cancel.type = "button";
      cancel.addEventListener("click", function () { cancelOrder(); });
      last.appendChild(cancel);
      list.appendChild(last);
    }
    q("total").textContent = t("total") + " : " + money(state.total || 0);
    setBusy(state.busy);
  }

  function setBusy(busy) {
    modalEl.querySelectorAll(".mf-oe-minus, .mf-oe-plus, .mf-oe-remove, [data-oe=more]").forEach(function (b) {
      if (busy) { b.setAttribute("data-was-disabled", b.disabled ? "1" : "0"); b.disabled = true; }
    });
    modalEl.querySelector(".mf-oe-list").setAttribute("aria-busy", busy ? "true" : "false");
  }

  function applyData(d) {
    if (d.lines) { state.lines = d.lines; }
    if (typeof d.total === "number") { state.total = d.total; }
    if (d.menu_url) { state.menuUrl = d.menu_url; }
  }

  function changeLine(line, newQty) {
    if (!state || state.busy) return;
    state.busy = true; setBusy(true); setNotice("");
    api(state.orderId, "/modifier", { line_id: line.id, quantity: newQty, expected: line.quantity }).then(function (d) {
      if (!state) return;
      state.busy = false;
      if (d.ok) {
        applyData(d);
        state.changed = true;
        updateHost(state.orderId, d);
        var delta = d.changed.delta;
        setNotice(delta > 0 ? t("added", { qty: delta, name: d.changed.name })
                            : t("removed", { qty: -delta, name: d.changed.name }), "success");
      } else if (d.locked) {
        setNotice(t("locked"), "danger");
        state.changed = true;
        state.lines = []; state.total = 0;
        setTimeout(function () { if (modal) modal.hide(); }, 1800);
      } else if (d.stale || d.last_item || d.refused) {
        applyData(d);
        setNotice(d.last_item ? t("last") : (d.refused ? d.error : t("stale")), d.refused ? "danger" : "warning");
      } else if (d.__status === 404) {
        setNotice(t("notmine"), "danger");
      } else {
        setNotice(d.error || t("error"), "danger");
      }
      render();
    }).catch(function () {
      if (!state) return;
      state.busy = false; setNotice(t("error"), "danger"); render();
    });
  }

  // « Annuler la commande » : on réutilise le bouton existant (même fenêtre de confirmation).
  // Le bouton est cherché AU DERNIER MOMENT : « Mes commandes » reconstruit ses cartes régulièrement.
  function findCancelButton(id) {
    return document.querySelector('.mf-cancel-order-trigger[data-order-id="' + id + '"]') ||
           document.getElementById("cancel-order-btn");
  }
  function cancelOrder() {
    var id = state && state.orderId;
    if (!findCancelButton(id)) return;
    state.changed = false;
    modalEl.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", function once() {
      modalEl.removeEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", once);
      var btn = findCancelButton(id);
      if (btn) btn.click();
    });
    modal.hide();
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ « Ajouter d'autres plats » */
  function findAddButton(id) {
    return document.querySelector('.mf-addto-btn[data-order-id="' + id + '"]');
  }
  function rememberOrderOnThisDevice(id) {
    // Le panneau « Mes commandes » est construit depuis cette liste (app.js) : sans elle, la commande
    // ouverte depuis un lien de suivi n'y apparaîtrait pas et le mode ajout serait introuvable.
    try {
      var key = "mf_orders_" + slug();
      var ids = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      if (!Array.isArray(ids)) ids = [];
      if (ids.indexOf(id) === -1) { ids.push(id); localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(ids)); }
    } catch (e) { /* stockage indisponible : on tente quand même */ }
  }
  function addMore() {
    if (!state || state.busy) return;
    var id = state.orderId, url = state.menuUrl;
    var onMenu = !!findAddButton(id);
    if (!onMenu && url) state.onChanged = null;                    // on quitte la page : inutile de la recharger avant
    modalEl.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", function once() {
      modalEl.removeEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", once);
      var btn = findAddButton(id);
      if (btn) { btn.click(); return; }                             // menu déjà affiché : mode ajout existant
      if (url) { rememberOrderOnThisDevice(id); location.href = url; return; }   // page de suivi : on ouvre le menu
      flash(t("noAdd"));
    });
    modal.hide();
  }

  // Arrivée sur le menu avec ?ajouter=<id> : on déclenche le mode ajout de cette commande.
  function autoAddMode() {
    var m = location.search.match(/[?&]ajouter=(\d+)/);
    if (!m) return;
    var id = m[1], tries = 0;
    function strip() {
      try {
        var u = new URL(location.href); u.searchParams.delete("ajouter");
        history.replaceState(null, "", u.pathname + (u.search || "") + u.hash);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      var btn = findAddButton(id);
      if (btn) { clearInterval(timer); strip(); btn.click(); return; }
      if (++tries > 40) { clearInterval(timer); strip(); }     // 40 × 250 ms = 10 s : on abandonne en silence
    }, 250);
  }

  function open(orderId, onChanged) {
    if (typeof bootstrap === "undefined") return;
    ensureModal();
    state = { orderId: orderId, lines: null, total: 0, busy: false, changed: false, onChanged: onChanged, menuUrl: null };
    setNotice("");
    render();
    modal.show();
    api(orderId, "/lignes.json").then(function (d) {
      if (!state || state.orderId !== orderId) return;
      if (d.ok && d.editable) { applyData(d); }
      else if (d.ok) { setNotice(t("locked"), "danger"); state.lines = []; setTimeout(function () { if (modal) modal.hide(); }, 1800); }
      else { setNotice(d.__status === 404 ? t("notmine") : t("error"), "danger"); state.lines = []; }
      render();
    }).catch(function () {
      if (!state) return;
      setNotice(t("error"), "danger"); state.lines = []; render();
    });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ mise à jour de la page derrière la fenêtre */
  function updateHost(orderId, d) {
    var card = document.querySelector('.mf-myorder-card[data-order-id="' + orderId + '"]');
    if (!card || !d.items) return;
    var ul = card.querySelector(".mf-myorder-items");
    if (ul) {
      ul.textContent = "";
      d.items.forEach(function (it) { ul.appendChild(el("li", null, it.quantity + " × " + it.name)); });
    }
    var tot = card.querySelector(".mf-myorder-total");
    if (tot) tot.textContent = money(d.total);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ boutons */
  function buttonLabel(button) {
    // On ne réécrit le libellé que s'il a changé (changement de langue) : modifier la page à chaque
    // passage relancerait l'observateur de changements en boucle.
    var wanted = t("btn");
    if (button.getAttribute("data-oe-label") === wanted) return;
    var icon = el("i", "bi bi-pencil-square me-1");
    icon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    button.textContent = "";
    button.appendChild(icon);
    button.appendChild(document.createTextNode(wanted));
    button.setAttribute("data-oe-label", wanted);
  }

  function addToCards() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-myorder-card").forEach(function (card) {
      var actions = card.querySelector(".mf-myorder-actions");
      var cancel = card.querySelector(".mf-cancel-order-trigger");
      var existing = card.querySelector(".mf-myorder-editbtn");
      if (!actions || !cancel) { if (existing) existing.remove(); return; }      // plus modifiable
      if (existing) { buttonLabel(existing); return; }
      var id = parseInt(card.getAttribute("data-order-id"), 10);
      if (isNaN(id)) return;
      var b = el("button", "btn btn-primary btn-sm mf-myorder-editbtn");
      b.type = "button";
      buttonLabel(b);
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { open(id); });
      actions.insertBefore(b, cancel);
    });
  }

  function addToTracking() {
    var root = document.getElementById("order-status-root");
    var cancel = document.getElementById("cancel-order-btn");
    if (!root) return;
    var existing = document.getElementById("mf-oe-track-btn");
    var editable = root.getAttribute("data-status") === "nouvelle" && cancel && !cancel.classList.contains("d-none");
    if (!editable) { if (existing) existing.remove(); return; }
    if (existing) { buttonLabel(existing); return; }
    var m = (root.getAttribute("data-cancel-url") || "").match(/\/commande\/(\d+)\//);
    if (!m) return;
    var id = parseInt(m[1], 10);
    var b = el("button", "btn btn-primary btn-sm me-2");
    b.id = "mf-oe-track-btn"; b.type = "button";
    buttonLabel(b);
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { open(id, function () { location.reload(); }); });
    cancel.parentNode.insertBefore(b, cancel);
  }

  function scan() { addToCards(); addToTracking(); }

  function init() {
    injectCss();
    scan();
    autoAddMode();
    var host = document.getElementById("my-orders-offcanvas") || document.body;
    var pending = false;
    new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      setTimeout(function () { pending = false; scan(); }, 50);             // regroupe les rafraîchissements
    }).observe(host, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    var root = document.getElementById("order-status-root");
    if (root) new MutationObserver(scan).observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-status"], subtree: true, childList: true });
    document.querySelectorAll(".mf-lang-btn").forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(scan, 0); }); });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); else init();
})();
